checks.case: cantilever 40x80x2.3 tube, L 1000 mm, mesh 10 mm, 1 kN*m torque at the tip
checks.source: Bredt's thin-walled closed section: twist rate T / (G J), J = 4 Am^2 t / perimeter; shear T / (2 Am t); torque applied as the uniform shear flow on the tip ring, both ends free to warp; twist = rate * length; J from sections.rect_tube plus the walls' own torsion as plates, mid-line perimeter x t^3 / 3
checks.case_ja: 片持ちの角パイプ 40x80x2.3、長さ 1000 mm、要素の大きさ 10 mm、先に 1 kN·m のねじり
checks.source_ja: 閉じた薄肉断面 (Bredt の式): ねじれの割合 T / (G J)、J = 4 Am² t / 周の長さ。せん断応力 T / (2 Am t)。トルクは先の端の輪に一様なせん断流としてかけ、両端とも断面の反りは止めない。ねじれ角 = 割合 × 長さ。J は sections.rect_tube の値に、壁そのものの板としてのねじり (中心線の周の長さ × t³ / 3) を足す

checks.source: the fictitious drilling stiffness must not change the answer
checks.case_ja: 片持ちの角パイプ 40x80x2.3、先に 1 kN を下向きに: 面の中の回転 (ドリリング) の剛性 0.001 と 1e-06 で比べる
checks.source_ja: 計算のために足した仮の回転の剛性 (ドリリング) が、答えを変えてはいけない

checks.case: simply supported square plate 100 x 100 x 1, uniform 0.01 MPa, 16 x 16
checks.source: simply supported square plate, uniform pressure: Navier double series for the centre deflection (Timoshenko & Woinowsky-Krieger, Theory of Plates and Shells, 2nd ed. 1959), summed here
checks.case_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板 100 x 100 x 1、一様な圧力 0.01 MPa、16 x 16 要素
checks.source_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板に一様な圧力: 真ん中のたわみを Navier の二重級数で出し、ここで足し合わせる (Timoshenko & Woinowsky-Krieger, Theory of Plates and Shells, 2nd ed. 1959)

checks.case: plate W 100 x 300, central hole d 25 (d/W 0.25), tension 100 MPa
checks.source: finite-width plate with a central hole in tension: Kt_net = 2 + (1 - d/W)^3 (Heywood), Kt_gross = Kt_net / (1 - d/W); limit d/W -> 0 is Kirsch's 3. Formula as quoted in Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors (Pilkey & Pilkey, 3rd ed., Wiley 2008), chapter 4 (holes); not checked against the book here; FE value: element-centre sigma_yy of the two rings next to the hole on the x axis, extrapolated linearly in r to the edge
checks.case_ja: 幅 W 100 x 長さ 300 の板、真ん中に直径 25 の穴 (d/W 0.25)、100 MPa で引っぱる
checks.source_ja: 真ん中に穴のある幅の決まった板を引っぱる: Kt_net = 2 + (1 - d/W)³ (Heywood)、Kt_gross = Kt_net / (1 - d/W)。d/W → 0 で Kirsch の 3 になる。式は Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors (Pilkey & Pilkey, 3rd ed., Wiley 2008) の 4 章 (穴) に引かれている形 (Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors、確かめていない)。有限要素の値: x 軸の上で穴のすぐ外の 2 列の要素の中心の sigma_yy を、r について直線で穴の縁まで延ばした

checks.case: symmetric ladder at rest on four rigid wheels, shell mesh 20 mm
checks.source: the shell's weight (element masses lumped to the nodes, parts) equals the sum of the ground forces it is loaded with (K0 rigid-body statics of the design's masses); the difference is the mid-surface tubes overlapping at the joints
checks.case_ja: 左右対称のはしご形のフレームが 4 つの変形しない車輪の上で止まっている (シェルの要素の大きさ 20 mm)
checks.source_ja: シェルの重さ (要素の質量を節点に集めたものと部品) が、荷重として入れた地面の力 (K0 の剛体の力のつり合いで設計の質量から出したもの) の合計に等しい。差は継ぎ目で管の中心面が重なる分

checks.case: symmetric ladder at rest on four rigid wheels, shell mesh 20 mm
checks.source: loads balanced by inertia relief: the six holding restraints carry nothing (reaction / weight)
checks.case_ja: 左右対称のはしご形のフレームが 4 つの変形しない車輪の上で止まっている (シェルの要素の大きさ 20 mm)
checks.source_ja: 荷重は慣性リリーフでつり合う: 6 つの押さえ (拘束) は何も受けない (反力 / 重さ)

checks.case: symmetric ladder at rest on four rigid wheels, shell mesh 20 mm
checks.quantity: rail top wall outer axial stress at 490 mm behind the front joint
checks.source: beam bending -M c / I, M = (W_FL - half the front cross member's weight) s - w s^2 / 2 (free body of the rail ahead of the cut; symmetric, so the cross member puts no vertical moment into the rail), c = h/2, I from sections.rect_tube; W_FL from the K0 ground forces; element next to the middle of the upper wall (normal stress from the restrained twist of the rail, which the formula leaves out, is not zero there)
checks.case_ja: 左右対称のはしご形のフレームが 4 つの変形しない車輪の上で止まっている (シェルの要素の大きさ 20 mm)
checks.source_ja: 梁の曲げ -M c / I。M = (W_FL - 前の横の部材の重さの半分) s - w s² / 2 (切り口より前のレールだけを取り出して。左右対称なので、横の部材はレールに上下の向きのモーメントを入れない)、c = h/2、I は sections.rect_tube から。W_FL は K0 の地面の力から。上の壁の真ん中の隣の要素で (レールのねじれが止められて出る垂直応力は式に入っておらず、そこでも 0 ではない)

checks.case: symmetric ladder braking, grip 0.5 x each wheel load, shell mesh 20 mm
checks.source: d'Alembert: a = (ground forces + weight) / m = 0.5 g; within 1 % because the shell's tube mass (rho t area) differs slightly from the beam bookkeeping the forces were made with
checks.case_ja: 左右対称のはしご形のフレームがブレーキをかけている (どの車輪も荷重の 0.5 倍の力で地面をつかむ。シェルの要素の大きさ 20 mm)
checks.source_ja: ダランベールの原理: a = (地面の力 + 重さ) / m = 0.5 g。許容が 1 % なのは、シェルの管の質量 (密度 × 厚さ × 面積) が、力を作ったときの梁での計算とわずかに違うため

checks.case: symmetric ladder braking, grip 0.5 x each wheel load, shell mesh 20 mm
checks.source: inertia relief with an angular acceleration (the grip at the ground pitches the vehicle): the six holding restraints carry nothing
checks.case_ja: 左右対称のはしご形のフレームがブレーキをかけている (どの車輪も荷重の 0.5 倍の力で地面をつかむ。シェルの要素の大きさ 20 mm)
checks.source_ja: 角加速度も入れた慣性リリーフ (地面でつかむ力が車を前のめりに回す): 6 つの押さえ (拘束) は何も受けない

checks.case: simply supported square plate 100 x 100 x 1, uniform 0.01 MPa, meshes 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.source: simply supported square plate, uniform pressure: Navier double series for the bending moment at the centre, M_x = D sum a_mn ((m pi/a)^2 + nu (n pi/a)^2) sin(m pi/2) sin(n pi/2), a_mn = 16 q / (pi^6 D m n (m^2/a^2 + n^2/a^2)^2) (Timoshenko & Woinowsky-Krieger, Theory of Plates and Shells, 2nd ed. 1959; the series is summed here, the book's table not checked), surface stress 6 M_x / t^2; FE: mean of the four element centres around the plate centre; Richardson with the observed order (k1_shell.convergence)
checks.case_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板 100 x 100 x 1、一様な圧力 0.01 MPa、メッシュ 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.source_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板に一様な圧力: 真ん中の曲げモーメントを Navier の二重級数で出す。M_x = D Σ a_mn ((m π/a)² + ν (n π/a)²) sin(m π/2) sin(n π/2)、a_mn = 16 q / (π⁶ D m n (m²/a² + n²/a²)²)。級数はここで足し合わせる (Timoshenko & Woinowsky-Krieger, Theory of Plates and Shells, 2nd ed. 1959 の表、確かめていない)。表面の応力は 6 M_x / t²。有限要素の値: 板の真ん中を囲む 4 つの要素の中心の平均。見えた次数で Richardson の外挿 (k1_shell.convergence)

checks.case: simply supported square plate 100 x 100 x 1, uniform 0.01 MPa, meshes 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.quantity: observed order of the centre stress
checks.source: the centre stress of bilinear plate elements converges as h^2 (element-centre values around a symmetry point); HIRAKU's expectation, no source
checks.case_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板 100 x 100 x 1、一様な圧力 0.01 MPa、メッシュ 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.source_ja: 四角の板の要素 (双一次) の真ん中の応力は h² で答えに近づく (対称な点を囲む要素の中心の値)。HIRAKU の見込みで、出典はない

checks.case: simply supported square plate 100 x 100 x 1, uniform 0.01 MPa, meshes 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.source: change between the two finest levels below the 5 % limit and not singular
checks.case_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板 100 x 100 x 1、一様な圧力 0.01 MPa、メッシュ 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.source_ja: いちばん細かい 2 段のあいだの変化が限度の 5 % より小さく、応力が限りなく大きくなる点 (特異点) でもない

checks.case: simply supported square plate 100 x 100 x 1, uniform 0.01 MPa, meshes 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.quantity: error estimate falls with each refinement (finest / coarsest, global %)
checks.source: the Zienkiewicz-Zhu estimate of constant-stress elements on a smooth field falls as h^1 (halves per halving); got 37.2 / 17.1 / 8.3 %. Expectation from the element's order, tolerance HIRAKU's choice

checks.case: aligning moment on the generic corner, arm bushings stiff, tie rod 10 kN/mm: toe per N m
checks.source: rotation about the kingpin axis k: theta = M (k . z) / (k_t a^2), a = the tie rod's arm about k; toe change = theta (k . z)
checks.case_ja: 同じサスペンションで、腕のゴムは硬く、タイロッドだけ 10 kN/mm でたわむとき、タイヤを戻す回る力 1 N·m あたりのトー (向き) の変わり
checks.source_ja: キングピン (タイヤの向きが変わる軸) まわりに回る: 角度 = 回る力 × (軸の上下の向き) / (タイロッドの硬さ × 腕の長さ²)。トーの変わり = 角度 × (軸の上下の向き)

checks.case: all joint stiffnesses doubled: compliance halves
checks.source: linear springs; the stiff ball joints and wheel pad stay the same, so a little off
checks.case_ja: 腕のゴムとタイロッドの硬さを全部 2 倍にすると、力によるタイヤの向きの変わりが半分になるか
checks.source_ja: ばねは力に比例してたわむので半分になる。硬い玉継手と輪の台は 2 倍にしないので、少しずれてよい

checks.case: vertical 2 kN at the contact, level parallel arms: the damper carries it by the lever
checks.source: moment about the lower arm's axis: F_z L = D a (L = 400 mm to the ball joint, a = 300 mm to the damper)
checks.case_ja: 接地点に上向き 2 kN (腕は水平で平行): ダンパーがてこで受ける力
checks.source_ja: 下の腕の付け根の軸まわりの回る力のつり合い: 上の力 × 400 mm (玉継手まで) = ダンパーの力 × 300 mm (ダンパーまで)

checks.case: lateral 800 N at the contact 200 mm below the lower ball joint: the upper arm's pull
checks.source: moment about the lower ball joint: F_y c = F_u h (c = 200 mm, h = 300 mm between the ball joints)
checks.case_ja: 下の玉継手より 200 mm 下の接地点に横向き 800 N: 上の腕が引く力
checks.source_ja: 下の玉継手まわりの回る力のつり合い: 横の力 × 200 mm = 上の腕の力 × 300 mm (上下の玉継手の間)

checks.case: generic layout at 30 mm bump, tyre force (300, -900, 2500) N: the forces on the body add up to it
checks.source: balance of the whole corner: the body takes what the road gives
checks.case_ja: よくある形のサスペンションを 30 mm 縮め、タイヤに (300, -900, 2500) N: 車体の取付点の力の合計がタイヤの力と同じか
checks.source_ja: 隅全体の力のつり合い: 路面から受けた力を、車体がそのまま受ける

checks.source: Magic Formula: D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) peaks at D; dF/dx at x = 0 is B C D; D_x = mu_x F_z
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 前後の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: タイヤの式 D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) は、いちばん大きい値が D、滑り 0 での傾きが B C D。D = 摩擦係数 × 荷重

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: peak Fy
checks.source: Magic Formula: D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) peaks at D; dF/dx at x = 0 is B C D; D_y = mu_y F_z
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 横の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: タイヤの式 D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) は、いちばん大きい値が D、滑り 0 での傾きが B C D。D = 摩擦係数 × 荷重

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: slope dFx/dkappa at zero slip = the slip stiffness K0 takes
checks.source: Magic Formula: D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) peaks at D; dF/dx at x = 0 is B C D = K_xk (4.E15) scaled to the design
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 滑り 0 のときの前後の力の立ち上がり (手計算が使う前後の滑りの硬さと同じか)
checks.source_ja: タイヤの式 D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) は、いちばん大きい値が D、滑り 0 での傾きが B C D。式の K_xk (4.E15) を設計に合わせたもの

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: slope -dFy/dalpha at zero slip = the cornering stiffness K0 takes
checks.source: Magic Formula: D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) peaks at D; dF/dx at x = 0 is B C D = K_ya (4.E25) scaled to the design
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 横滑りの角度 0 のときの横の力の立ち上がり (手計算が使う曲がる硬さと同じか)
checks.source_ja: タイヤの式 D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) は、いちばん大きい値が D、滑り 0 での傾きが B C D。式の K_ya (4.E25) を設計に合わせたもの

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: combined slip, kappa -1..1 and alpha -55..55 deg: largest hypot(Fx/Dx, Fy/Dy)
checks.source: the friction ellipse of the pure-slip peaks; the combined-slip weighting is a fit, so 5 % over is allowed
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 前後と横に同時に滑らせたとき (前後の滑り -1〜1、横滑りの角度 -55〜55°)、力が摩擦の楕円の外に出ないか
checks.source_ja: 前後だけ・横だけのときのいちばん大きい力で作る摩擦の楕円。同時に滑るときの式は測定に合わせた形なので、5 % まで外に出てよい

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: aligning moment at alpha +2 deg and -2 deg turns the wheel toward its motion (Mz(+2) > 0 > Mz(-2))
checks.source: ISO signs: positive alpha slides the contact to the left, and the moment turns the heading that way
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 横滑りの角度 +2° と -2° で、タイヤを戻す回る力が、進む向きにタイヤを向けるか
checks.source_ja: ISO の符号の決まり: 横滑りの角度が + なら接地点は左に滑り、回る力はタイヤをその向きに回す

checks.case: rigid vehicle, wheelbase 1.8 m, track 1.2 m, inner wheel 30 deg, 2 m/s: outer front wheel's turning radius
checks.source: Ackermann: cot(delta_o) = cot(delta_i) + t / L, R = L / sin(delta_o) (turning.min_radius)
checks.case_ja: サスペンションの無い車 (軸距 1.8 m、輪距 1.2 m) を、内側の前輪 30° の全切りで 2 m/s で回す: 外側の前輪の回る円の半径
checks.source_ja: アッカーマンの舵: cot δ外 = cot δ内 + 輪距 / 軸距、半径 = 軸距 / sin δ外 (turning.min_radius)

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: peak Fy

checks.source_ja: タイヤの式 D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) は、いちばん大きい値が D、滑り 0 での傾きが B C D。D = 摩擦係数 × 荷重

checks.source_ja: タイヤの式 D sin(C atan(B x - E (B x - atan B x))) は、いちばん大きい値が D、滑り 0 での傾きが B C D。式の K_xk (4.E15) を設計に合わせたもの

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: combined slip, kappa -1..1 and alpha -55..55 deg: largest hypot(Fx/Dx, Fy/Dy)
checks.source: the friction ellipse of the pure-slip peaks; the combined-slip weighting is a fit, so 5 % over is allowed
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 前後と横に同時に滑らせたとき (前後の滑り -1〜1、横滑りの角度 -55〜55°)、力が摩擦の楕円の外に出ないか
checks.source_ja: 前後だけ・横だけのときのいちばん大きい力で作る摩擦の楕円。同時に滑るときの式は測定に合わせた形なので、5 % まで外に出てよい

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: aligning moment at alpha +2 deg and -2 deg turns the wheel toward its motion (Mz(+2) > 0 > Mz(-2))
checks.source: ISO signs: positive alpha slides the contact to the left, and the moment turns the heading that way
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 横滑りの角度 +2° と -2° で、タイヤを戻す回る力が、進む向きにタイヤを向けるか
checks.source_ja: ISO の符号の決まり: 横滑りの角度が + なら接地点は左に滑り、回る力はタイヤをその向きに回す

checks.case: cantilever 40x80x2.3 steel tube, 1 m, 4 elements, 50 N at the tip, held by damping: tip deflection
checks.source: P L^3 / (3 E I), Euler-Bernoulli cantilever
checks.case_ja: 長さ 1 m の角パイプ (40×80×2.3、鋼) の片持ちの梁の先に 50 N をかけ、揺れを止めて読んだ先のたわみ
checks.source_ja: 片持ちの梁の先の荷重のたわみ P L³ / (3 E I)

checks.case: the same cantilever's tip pushed slowly 45 mm (first yield at 12.3 mm): tip force on the plateau
checks.source: M_p / L, the plastic hinge at the root (M_p = Z_p f_y)
checks.case_ja: 同じ片持ちの梁の先を、ゆっくり 45 mm 押し下げる (降伏は 12.3 mm で始まる): 押す力が頭打ちになった所の大きさ
checks.source_ja: 根元に塑性ヒンジができて崩れる荷重 M_p / L (M_p = 塑性断面係数 × 降伏応力)

checks.case: 2000 kg on a 0.5 m elastic 40x40x2.3 tube hits the wall at 1 m/s (k = E A / L in series with the wall's penalty spring, 107.7 kN/mm): peak wall force
checks.source: undamped mass-spring impact: F = v sqrt(k m), m with a third of the tube's mass
checks.case_ja: 弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) の後ろに 2000 kg を載せ、1 m/s で壁に当てる (ばね = パイプの E A / L と壁の押し返しのばねの直列、107.7 kN/mm): 壁の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: 減衰のない質量とばねの衝突: F = v √(k m) (m にはパイプの重さの 1/3 を足す)

checks.case: 2000 kg on a 0.5 m elastic 40x40x2.3 tube hits the wall at 1 m/s (k = E A / L in series with the wall's penalty spring, 107.7 kN/mm): contact time
checks.source: half a period of the mass on the spring: pi sqrt(m / k)
checks.case_ja: 弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) の後ろに 2000 kg を載せ、1 m/s で壁に当てる (ばね = パイプの E A / L と壁の押し返しのばねの直列、107.7 kN/mm): 壁に触れている時間
checks.source_ja: 質量とばねの揺れの半周期 π √(m / k)

checks.case: 2000 kg on a 0.5 m elastic 40x40x2.3 tube hits the wall at 1 m/s (k = E A / L in series with the wall's penalty spring, 107.7 kN/mm): speed change of the whole mass (momentum change / mass) = the wall's impulse / mass
checks.source: Newton's second law over the run: the beams' internal forces cancel
checks.case_ja: 弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) の後ろに 2000 kg を載せ、1 m/s で壁に当てる (ばね = パイプの E A / L と壁の押し返しのばねの直列、107.7 kN/mm): 全体の運動量の変わり (全体の重さで割って速さの変わりにした) が、壁から受けた力積と同じか
checks.source_ja: 運動の法則: 梁の中の力は打ち消し合うので、運動量を変えるのは壁の力だけ

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): peak contact force
checks.source: undamped impact of two masses through a spring: F = v sqrt(k mu), mu the reduced mass (each with a third of its tube)
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 接触の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: 減衰のない 2 つの質量のばねを介した衝突: F = v √(k μ) (μ は換算質量)

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): contact time
checks.source: half a period: pi sqrt(mu / k)
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 触れている時間
checks.source_ja: 半周期 π √(μ / k)

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): speed of the struck tube after
checks.source: elastic impact (momentum and energy kept): v2' = 2 M1 / (M1 + M2) v
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 当てられた側の、離れたあとの速さ
checks.source_ja: 弾性衝突 (運動量とエネルギーが保たれる): v2' = 2 M1 / (M1 + M2) v

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): the total momentum after / before
checks.source: the contact forces are equal and opposite: the momentum is kept
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 全体の運動量の、後と前の比
checks.source_ja: 接触の力は向きが反対で大きさが同じなので、運動量は保たれる

checks.case: a 40x40x2.3 tube 0.6 m long moving at 2 m/s crosswise onto another at rest (no gravity): the least distance between the axes (the contact radii sum to 40 mm; the penetration bound 0.34 mm)
checks.source: all the relative kinetic energy in the contact spring at most: penetration <= v sqrt(mu / k), k the contact's penalty spring at the middles
checks.case_ja: 角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.6 m) を、止まっているもう 1 本の上に 2 m/s で十字に落とす (重力なし): 2 本の軸のいちばん近い距離 (接触の半径の和からのめり込みが上限 0.34 mm 以内か)
checks.source_ja: 相対の運動エネルギーが全部接触のばねに入っても、めり込みは v √(μ / k) まで

checks.case: a wheel node (18 kg, radius 0.3 m, tyre 60 N/mm, section height 120 mm) moving at 1 m/s into the wall (the rim does not reach it): peak wall force
checks.source: undamped mass-spring impact: F = v sqrt(k_t m)
checks.case_ja: 車輪の点 (18 kg、半径 0.3 m、タイヤのばね 60 N/mm、タイヤの断面の高さ 120 mm) を 1 m/s で壁に当てる (リムは壁に届かない): 壁の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: 減衰のない質量とばねの衝突: F = v √(k_t m)

checks.case: a wheel node (18 kg, radius 0.3 m, tyre 60 N/mm, section height 120 mm) moving at 1 m/s into the wall (the rim does not reach it): contact time
checks.source: half a period of the mass on the tyre's spring: pi sqrt(m / k_t)
checks.case_ja: 車輪の点 (18 kg、半径 0.3 m、タイヤのばね 60 N/mm、タイヤの断面の高さ 120 mm) を 1 m/s で壁に当てる (リムは壁に届かない): 壁に触れている時間
checks.source_ja: 質量とばねの揺れの半周期 π √(m / k_t)

checks.case: the same wheel node at 40 km/h (the free tyre would deflect 192 mm, more than its section height): the deepest x of the node
checks.source: the rim (radius r - section height) reaches the wall and stops there, perfectly plastic: x = wall - (r - h)
checks.case_ja: 同じ車輪の点を 40 km/h で当てる (タイヤのたわみが断面の高さを超える): 点がいちばん進んだ x
checks.source_ja: リム (半径 = r - タイヤの断面の高さ) が壁に届いたらそこで止まる (跳ね返らない): x = 壁 - (r - h)

formulas.title: 剛い輪が段の角に当たったときに要る押す力
formulas.expression: d = sqrt(2*r*h - h^2); F = W*d/(r - h)

W.description: vertical load carried by this wheel at the moment it climbs

F.description: horizontal push at the axle that lifts the wheel onto the corner

d.description: horizontal distance from the wheel centre to the step corner

assumptions: rigid wheel and rigid step corner
quasi-static: no speed or impact effect
at lift-off the whole wheel load rests on the corner
h < r
the push acts at the axle, so the corner reaction points at the wheel centre
formulas.source: static equilibrium of a rigid wheel on a step corner (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 剛い輪が越えられる段の高さ (輪の半径まで)
formulas.expression: climbable = 1 if h < r else 0; step_margin = r - h; max_step = r

climbable.description: 1 when a rigid wheel can be lifted onto the step, 0 when it cannot

step_margin.description: how far the step stays below the wheel centre (negative: too high)

max_step.description: the highest step a rigid wheel can climb (its radius)

assumptions: rigid wheel and rigid step corner
at h >= r the corner meets the wheel at or above its centre, so the corner's push on the wheel has no upward part and no push at the axle lifts it; a tyre that deflects is not counted
formulas.source: static equilibrium of a rigid wheel on a step corner (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 後輪に押されて前輪が段を登るときの前輪 1 本の荷重と押す力
formulas.expression: k = sqrt(2*r*h - h^2)/(r - h); W = m*g*(L - a)/(L*n) / (1 + k*r/L); F = k*W

a.description: distance from the front axle back to the centre of gravity (positive rearward)

n.description: number of front wheels on the step

W.description: vertical load on one front wheel at the moment it lifts off

F.description: push on one front wheel (k W)

assumptions: rigid wheels; quasi-static at the moment the front wheels lift off
the rear wheels push with traction at the ground; the step pushes back at the front axle height r
that couple (k W r) moves load from the front to the rear axle
centre of gravity on the centre line; all front wheels on the step
formulas.source: moment balance of the whole vehicle about the rear contact line (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 押されずに輪が自分のトルクで段を登るのに要るトルクと摩擦
formulas.expression: d = sqrt(2*r*h - h^2); tau = W*d; mu = d/(r - h)

W.description: vertical load carried by this wheel at the moment it climbs

tau.description: axle torque for the wheel to climb by itself

mu.description: friction coefficient the wheel needs at the step corner

assumptions: rigid wheel and rigid step corner
quasi-static: no speed or impact effect
at lift-off the whole wheel load rests on the corner
h < r
the body does not push: the corner reaction is vertical and the wheel torque turns it about the corner
formulas.source: static equilibrium of a rigid wheel on a step corner (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 止まっているときの各輪の荷重 (てこの比)
formulas.expression: front = m*g*(L - a)/L; rear = m*g*a/L; wheel_load_FL = front*(1/2 + e/t); wheel_load_FR = front*(1/2 - e/t); same for RL/RR with rear

m.description: total mass of the vehicle with its load

a.description: distance from the front axle back to the centre of gravity

e.description: sideways offset of the centre of gravity, positive to the left (0 when centred)

assumptions: rigid body at rest on level ground, all four wheels touching
front/rear split by the lever rule, then left/right split by the lever rule on each axle
frame and spring stiffness are ignored (no warp)
formulas.source: static equilibrium (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 止まっているときの前輪 1 本の荷重 (てこの比)
formulas.expression: W = m*g*(L - a)/(L*n)

a.description: distance from the front axle back to the centre of gravity (positive rearward)

assumptions: rigid body at rest on level ground
front/rear split by the lever rule
the front axle load shared equally by the front wheels (centre of gravity on the centre line)
formulas.source: static equilibrium (textbook statics)

formulas.title: レールを両端で支えた梁とみて、真ん中に力をかけたときの曲げ応力

F.description: force on the rail, across it (e.g. the wheel force brought in by the suspension)

L.description: span of the rail between its supports

sigma.description: bending stress at mid-span, outer face

assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam: linear elastic, small deflection, no shear deformation
rectangular tube bent about the axis across its width (stress at the top and bottom faces)
self-weight not included unless it is the load
one rail as a simply supported beam, the force at mid-span
the force bends the rail about the axis across its width
formulas.source: simply supported beam with a centre load, M = F L / 4, sigma = M / Z (textbook beam tables)

formulas.title: 両端を支えた角パイプの梁に 1 点の荷重
formulas.expression: M = P*a*(L - a)/L; max_stress = M*(h/2)/I; deflection at the load = P*a^2*(L - a)^2/(3*E*I*L); I = (b*h^3 - (b-2t)*(h-2t)^3)/12

a.description: distance from the left support to the load

assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam: linear elastic, small deflection, no shear deformation
rectangular tube bent about the axis across its width (stress at the top and bottom faces)
self-weight not included unless it is the load
simple supports at both ends (free to rotate)
formulas.source: simply supported beam with a point load (textbook beam tables)

formulas.title: 両端を支えた角パイプの梁の真ん中に荷重
formulas.expression: M = P*L/4; max_stress = M*(h/2)/I; max_displacement = P*L^3/(48*E*I)
assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam: linear elastic, small deflection, no shear deformation
rectangular tube bent about the axis across its width (stress at the top and bottom faces)
self-weight not included unless it is the load
simple supports at both ends (free to rotate)
formulas.source: simply supported beam with a centre load (textbook beam tables)

formulas.title: 両端を支えた角パイプの梁に一様な荷重
formulas.expression: M = w*L^2/8; max_stress = M*(h/2)/I; max_displacement = 5*w*L^4/(384*E*I)
assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam: linear elastic, small deflection, no shear deformation
rectangular tube bent about the axis across its width (stress at the top and bottom faces)
self-weight not included unless it is the load
simple supports at both ends (free to rotate)
formulas.source: simply supported beam with a uniform load (textbook beam tables)

formulas.title: 片持ちの角パイプの先に荷重
formulas.expression: M = P*L; max_stress = M*(h/2)/I; max_displacement = P*L^3/(3*E*I)

max_stress.description: largest bending stress (at the fixed end)

max_moment.description: largest bending moment (at the fixed end)

assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam: linear elastic, small deflection, no shear deformation
rectangular tube bent about the axis across its width (stress at the top and bottom faces)
self-weight not included unless it is the load
fully fixed at one end
formulas.source: cantilever with an end load (textbook beam tables)

formulas.title: 角パイプの曲げ応力 M/Z

max_stress.description: bending stress at the outer face

assumptions: linear elastic
pure bending about the axis across the width
formulas.source: beam bending stress sigma = M/Z (textbook)

formulas.title: 段差を押して登るときのレールの曲げ応力 (両端を車軸で支えた梁)
formulas.expression: M(x) = w x (L - x)/2 - M_A (1 - x/L) - M_B x/L; w = W/(2L); M_A = F (z - r); M_B = F z; sigma = max|M|/Z + F/A

W.description: weight carried by the frame (the sprung weight; the whole weight is on the safe side)

L.description: wheelbase (the rail's span between the axles)

F.description: push of the step on one front wheel (P1's front_wheel_force)

z.description: height of the rail's centre line above the ground

r.description: wheel radius (the push acts at the front wheel centre)

sigma.description: largest stress along the rail between the axles (bending and the push as compression)

M_rear.description: hogging moment at the rear axle

x_max.description: where the largest stress is, measured back from the front axle

assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam: linear elastic, small deflection, no shear deformation
rectangular tube bent about the axis across its width (stress at the top and bottom faces)
one rail as a beam simply supported at the two axles, carrying half the weight as a uniform load
both front wheels on the step, pushed by the two rear wheels with the same force F each
the push and the traction act below the rail and reach it as end moments F (z - r) and F z
loads behind the rear axle (overhang), sideways bending and torsion are not included
formulas.source: superposition of a simply supported beam under a uniform load and end moments (textbook beam tables)

formulas.title: 段差を押して登るときの後ろの車軸の所のレールの応力 (張り出し・横の曲げ・ねじりを入れる)
formulas.expression: M_v = M_oh + F z; T = W e kt/(kt + kc,v); M_l = F e kl/(kl + kc,l); kt = G J/L1, kl = 4 E I_l/L1, kc = 2 E I_c/L_c; sigma = F/A + M_v (h/2)/I_v + M_l (b/2)/I_l; von Mises sqrt(sigma^2 + 3 tau^2), tau = T/(2 A_m t)

M_oh.description: hogging moment at the joint from the loads on this rail behind the axle (rail_joint_inputs computes it from the part masses and x positions)

F.description: push of the step on one front wheel = traction of one rear wheel (P1 front_wheel_force)

W.description: vertical load on the rear wheel while climbing (P1 wheel_load of that wheel)

z.description: height of the rail centre above the ground (lever of the traction)

e.description: sideways offset of the wheel centre from the rail centre

L1.description: length of the rail piece ahead of the joint

L_c.description: length of the cross member at the joint

sigma.description: von Mises stress at the worst corner of the rail at the joint

sigma_sideways.description: from sideways bending (traction at the wheel offset)

tau_torsion.description: shear from the twist (wheel load at the offset)

M_vertical.description: vertical bending moment in the rail at the joint

M_sideways.description: sideways bending moment in the rail at the joint

T_rail.description: torque in the rail at the joint

assumptions: both front wheels on the step, each rear wheel pushes with F; quasi-static
left and right loaded alike (mirror images)
the wheel's loads reach the rail at the joint through the suspension, with the moments of the offset e
one step of moment distribution at the joint: far ends of the rail ahead held, the rail behind free at its end
loads behind the axle enter at their carried_by nodes, shared equally (no transfer moments)
thin-walled rectangular tubes (Bredt torsion); shear from transverse forces left out
formulas.source: beam statics, moment distribution at one joint (Hardy Cross) and Bredt's torsion formula (textbook structures)

formulas.title: 段差を押して登るときの後ろの車軸の所のレールの応力 (後ろの張り出しを端の横の部材が閉じる)
formulas.expression: as frame_static.rail_joint_stress, the twist W e and the sideways moment F e shared also with the rail behind: k_bt = 1/(a/(G J) + L_e/(2 E I_e,v)), k_bl = 4c(3c + k_e)/(4c + k_e), c = E I_l/a, k_e = 2 E I_e,l/L_e; sigma = the larger of the rail's two sides at the joint

M_oh.description: hogging moment at the joint from the loads on this rail behind the axle (rail_joint_inputs computes it from the part masses and x positions)

F.description: push of the step on one front wheel = traction of one rear wheel (P1 front_wheel_force)

W.description: vertical load on the rear wheel while climbing (P1 wheel_load of that wheel)

z.description: height of the rail centre above the ground (lever of the traction)

e.description: sideways offset of the wheel centre from the rail centre

L1.description: length of the rail piece ahead of the joint

L_c.description: length of the cross member at the joint

a.description: length of the rail behind the joint to the end cross member

L_e.description: length of the end cross member

sigma.description: von Mises stress at the worst corner of the rail at the joint

sigma_sideways.description: from sideways bending (traction at the wheel offset)

tau_torsion.description: shear from the twist (wheel load at the offset)

M_vertical.description: vertical bending moment in the rail at the joint

M_sideways.description: sideways bending moment in the rail at the joint

T_rail.description: torque in the rail at the joint

sigma_ahead.description: von Mises in the rail just ahead of the joint

sigma_behind.description: von Mises in the rail just behind the joint

assumptions: both front wheels on the step, each rear wheel pushes with F; quasi-static
left and right loaded alike (mirror images)
the wheel's loads reach the rail at the joint through the suspension, with the moments of the offset e

one step of moment distribution at the joint between three members: the rail ahead (its far end held), the cross member at the joint, and the rail behind, whose far end the end cross member holds (a ladder closed at the rear). frame_static.rail_joint_stress takes the rail behind as free: it leaves out that share
the end cross member bent by mirror-image moments from both rails (2 E I / L_e)
loads behind the axle enter at their carried_by nodes, shared equally (no transfer moments)
thin-walled rectangular tubes (Bredt torsion); shear from transverse forces left out
formulas.source: beam statics, moment distribution at one joint (Hardy Cross), a beam with a rotational spring at its far end, and Bredt's torsion formula (textbook structures)

formulas.title: 後ろの張り出しの端の横の部材の応力 (輪 1 つに 1 kN、輪のずれのねじりとはしごのねじれ)
formulas.expression: symmetric: M = 1000 e k_o/(k_o + k_j + k_f) / 2, k_o = 1/(a/(G J) + w/(2 E I_c)), k_j = 2 E I_j/w, k_f = G J/L1; antisymmetric: M = misfit / (w/(6 E I_c) + give_per_kNm/1e6) / 2; sigma_ra,rb = (M_sym +- M_anti_rear) (h_c/2)/I_c, sigma_fa,fb = +-M_anti_front (h_c/2)/I_c

e.description: sideways offset of the wheel centre outboard of the rail centre

a.description: length of the rail behind the rear joint (the overhang)

w.description: distance between the rail centres (length of the cross members)

L1.description: length of the rail piece ahead of the rear joint

b_j.description: cross member at the joint, width

misfit_rear.description: for 1 kN up at the left and down at the right rear wheel: how far the rails' own turn and the chord's turn part at the rail ends when the end cross member does not bend (end_cross_member_inputs, from a beam chain of the ladder's antisymmetric half with inertia relief)

misfit_front.description: the same for the front wheels, with its sign against misfit_rear (negative: the end cross member is bent the other way)

give_per_kNm.description: how far the rest of the frame lets that mismatch close for 1 kN*m at each end of the end cross member (with its shears): the rails' torsion and bending behind the joint, the joint's cross member, the ladder ahead (end_cross_member_inputs)

sigma_ra.description: stress at the corner of the end cross member where the rear wheels' effects add, for 1 kN up at rear wheel a (the left one)

sigma_rb.description: stress at the corner of the end cross member where the rear wheels' effects add, for 1 kN up at rear wheel b (the right one)

sigma_fa.description: stress at the corner of the end cross member where the rear wheels' effects add, for 1 kN up at front wheel a (left, same track as rear a)

sigma_fb.description: stress at the corner of the end cross member where the rear wheels' effects add, for 1 kN up at front wheel b

M_sym.description: end cross member moment from 1 kN on one rear wheel, symmetric half

M_anti_front.description: end cross member moment from 1 kN on one front wheel (antisymmetric half), signed against M_anti_rear

assumptions: the wheel's force reaches the rail at the rear joint with the twist of its sideways offset e
symmetric half: one step of moment distribution at the joint (far end of the rail ahead held)

antisymmetric half: the end cross member is the one redundant; misfit and give come from a beam chain of the ladder's antisymmetric half (rails' opposite bending and torsion between stations, cross members' double-curvature bending and torsion at the stations), the wheel's force with the moment of its offset at its frame node, the roll moment taken by the masses' d'Alembert loads (inertia relief) shared over the frame nodes as the beam model shares them
the end cross member's corner stress from its vertical bending only (its sideways bending and axial force are left out)
the weights' own bending of the overhang rails is not counted (it does not bend the end cross member)
thin-walled rectangular tubes (Bredt torsion), sharp corners
formulas.source: beam statics, moment distribution at one joint (Hardy Cross), Bredt's torsion formula and the force method with one redundant on a beam chain of the ladder frame (textbook structures)

formulas.title: 横の部材の端のモーメントで、レールの側の壁が板として曲がる応力 (つなぎ目の壁の曲げ)
formulas.expression: line loads of the cross member's walls q = M z t_c / I_c (I_c = t_c (H^3/6 + B H^2/2), B = b_c - t_c, H = h_c - t_c) on a plate strip a = h - t wide, simply supported at the rail's upper and lower walls (Levy series, D = E t^3/(12 (1 - nu^2))); sigma = max von Mises of 6 m/t^2; theta_per_kNm = work / M at M = 1 kN*m; gussets: upper and lower loads over B + 2 leg; through: sigma = sqrt(3) M / ((b - t) 2 H t), rigid

M.description: the cross member's end moment at the joint about the rail's axis (frame_inputs.joint_wall_inputs shares the wheels' twisting moments among the cross members)

b.description: rail tube width (across the wall's plane)

leg.description: gusset leg along the rail (0: no gussets)

through.description: 1: the cross member runs through the rail to its far wall

open_end.description: 1: the rail ends at this joint (L joint)

sigma.description: largest surface von Mises in the rail's side wall from its plate bending (through: from the in-plane shear)

sigma_open_end.description: the same with a free edge where the rail ends (L joints; a bound, see the assumptions)

theta_per_kNm.description: rotation of the joint for 1 kN*m from the wall's bending (0: rigid); the joint's rotation stiffness is 1e6 N*mm / theta_per_kNm

M_flange_force.description: force in the cross member's upper (lower) wall line if it carried all of M

x_peak.description: where sigma is, along the rail from the cross member's centre line

z_peak.description: where sigma is, up from the middle of the rail's side wall (signed)

assumptions: Kirchhoff plate, linear elastic; the rail's side wall simply supported along its upper and lower walls (their rotational restraint is not counted) and running on along the rail both ways
the cross member's end loads the wall as line loads of thin-walled beam bending (force-controlled; the end ring's own stiffness, which would draw load to its corners, is not counted)
only the moment about the rail's axis (the cross member's vertical bending); its axial force, sideways bending and torsion are left out
membrane stress in the wall is left out (wall bending only)
L joint (open_end = 1): the cross member's end wall is taken to close the rail's end over the joint, so the wall runs on; sigma_open_end with a free edge there is a bound, not the estimate
gussets: the upper and lower wall loads spread evenly over the gussets' welds along the rail; the plates' own stiffness is not counted
through: the moment goes into both side walls as in-plane shear along the cross member's side walls; the joint is rigid

against the K1 shell's hot spots (R1 step, 10 mm): butt and gusset ladders -4 to -13 %, but at the rail-end L joints by two errors that cancel (the chain gives them too much moment, the closed-end wall too little stress per moment); with through cross members the rail-end joint comes out 23 to 41 % low. Not counted: the rail's section distortion at its open end (a beam on an elastic foundation in the shell's numbers) and how the wheel mount puts its load onto the wall
formulas.source: Kirchhoff plate theory, Levy's single-series solution of a strip simply supported on two edges, and thin-walled beam bending (textbook plates and shells, e.g. Timoshenko and Woinowsky-Krieger, Theory of Plates and Shells; the series is evaluated by code here, no table values are used)

formulas.title: 傾斜台で倒れる角度 (剛体)
formulas.expression: theta = atan((t/2 - e)/h); ssf = (t/2 - e)/h

h.description: height of the centre of gravity

e.description: sideways offset of the centre of gravity toward the low side (0 when centred)

theta.description: table angle at which the high-side wheels lift

ssf.description: static stability factor (t/2 - e)/h (T/2h when centred)

assumptions: rigid suspension and tyres
the vehicle tips about the line through the low-side tyre contacts
same track front and rear
the tyres do not slide (check tilt.slide_angle)
formulas.source: moment balance about the low-side contact line (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 傾斜台で倒れる角度 (ばねで車体がロールする分を入れる)
formulas.expression: tan(theta) = (t/2 - e - (m_s/m) h_s sin(phi)) / (h - (m_s/m) h_s (1 - cos(phi))); K_phi phi = m_s g h_s sin(theta + phi); K_phi = n k t^2 / 2

h.description: height of the centre of gravity

e.description: sideways offset of the centre of gravity toward the low side (0 when centred)

h_s.description: height of the sprung centre of gravity above the roll axis

k.description: vertical rate of one wheel's suspension (at the wheel)

theta.description: table angle at which the high-side wheels lift

roll.description: body roll on the springs at that angle

assumptions: the body rolls about a fixed roll axis on linear springs; tyres are rigid
the unsprung mass stays with the axles
tips about the low-side contact line
same track front and rear
formulas.source: moment balance about the low-side contact line with roll equilibrium of the sprung mass (textbook vehicle dynamics)

formulas.title: 横の斜面に止まっているときの、上の側の輪の荷重の和
formulas.expression: W_up = m g (cos(beta) (t/2 - e) - sin(beta) h) / t

h.description: height of the centre of gravity above the slope

e.description: sideways offset of the centre of gravity toward the low side (0 when centred)

W_up.description: load on the uphill wheels together (they lift at 0)

assumptions: rigid suspension and tyres
standing still on a plane side slope
moment balance about the line through the downhill tyre contacts
same track front and rear
formulas.source: moment balance about the downhill contact line (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 傾斜台で滑り出す角度
formulas.expression: theta = atan(mu)

mu.description: friction coefficient between tyre and table

theta.description: table angle at which the vehicle slides sideways

assumptions: Coulomb friction
if this is below the tip angle, the vehicle slides before it tips
formulas.source: friction on an inclined plane (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 横風の力
formulas.expression: F = 1/2 rho C_y A v^2

C_y.description: side force coefficient (take the unfavourable end of its range)

A.description: side area seen by the wind

v.description: wind speed relative to the vehicle, across it

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

F.description: side force

assumptions: steady wind across the vehicle
formulas.source: aerodynamic force F = 1/2 rho C A v^2 (textbook fluid mechanics)

formulas.title: 横風を受けたときの風上の輪の荷重
formulas.expression: W_windward = m g / 2 - F h_cp / t

F.description: side force of the wind

h_cp.description: height of the centre of pressure above the ground

W_windward.description: load left on the windward wheels together (lift when it reaches 0)

assumptions: rigid vehicle, no roll
centre of gravity on the centre line
the vehicle tips about the leeward contact line
no aerodynamic lift
formulas.source: moment balance about the leeward contact line (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 風上の輪が浮く風速
formulas.expression: v_crit = sqrt(m g t / (rho C_y A h_cp))

C_y.description: side force coefficient (take the unfavourable end of its range)

A.description: side area seen by the wind

h_cp.description: height of the centre of pressure above the ground

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

v_crit.description: relative wind speed at which the windward wheels lift

assumptions: steady wind across the vehicle
rigid vehicle, no roll
centre of gravity on the centre line
no aerodynamic lift
formulas.source: 1/2 rho C_y A v^2 h_cp = m g t / 2 (textbook statics and fluid mechanics)

formulas.title: 空気抵抗の力
formulas.expression: F = 1/2 rho C_d A v^2

v.description: air speed relative to the vehicle, along it (the driving speed in still air)

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

F.description: drag force

assumptions: steady flow along the vehicle
still air
formulas.source: drag equation F = 1/2 rho C_d A v^2 (textbook fluid mechanics)

formulas.title: 曲がっているときの内側の輪の荷重 (剛体)
formulas.expression: W_inner = m g / 2 - m a_y h / t; a_y_lift = t / (2 h)

h.description: height of the centre of gravity

W_inner.description: load on the inner wheels together (they lift at 0)

a_y_lift.description: lateral acceleration at which the inner wheels lift

assumptions: steady cornering
rigid suspension and tyres
centre of gravity on the centre line
formulas.source: moment balance about the outer contact line (textbook vehicle dynamics)

formulas.title: 内側の輪が浮く横加速度 (ばねで車体がロールする分を入れる)
formulas.expression: R = m_s g h_s / (K_phi - m_s g h_s); a_y_lift = (t/2) / (h + (m_s/m) h_s R); K_phi = n k t^2 / 2

h.description: height of the centre of gravity

h_s.description: height of the sprung centre of gravity above the roll axis

k.description: vertical rate of one wheel's suspension (at the wheel)

a_y_lift.description: lateral acceleration at which the inner wheels lift

assumptions: steady cornering
small roll angle (linear)
the body rolls about a fixed roll axis; tyres are rigid
centre of gravity on the centre line
formulas.source: steady-state rollover threshold with suspension roll (textbook vehicle dynamics)

formulas.title: 車線変更の道筋で要る横加速度の最大
formulas.expression: y(x) = Y/2 (1 - cos(pi x / X)); a_y_peak = v^2 * Y/2 * (pi/X)^2

X.description: length over which the shift is made

a_y_peak.description: largest lateral acceleration on the path

assumptions: the vehicle follows a half-cosine path exactly at constant speed
small path angle
formulas.source: curvature of y = Y/2 (1 - cos(pi x / X)) times v^2 (geometry)

formulas.title: 一定の円を回るときの舵角 (2 輪モデル)
formulas.expression: delta = L/R + K a_y; K = W_f/C_af - W_r/C_ar; a_y = v^2/(R g)

C_f.description: cornering stiffness of the front axle (both tyres)

C_r.description: cornering stiffness of the rear axle (both tyres)

K.description: understeer gradient: extra steer per 1 g (positive = understeer)

assumptions: linear tyres (cornering force proportional to slip angle)
small angles
steady state
no load transfer effect on cornering stiffness
formulas.source: steady-state bicycle model (textbook vehicle dynamics)

formulas.title: 急ブレーキで止まるまでの距離
formulas.expression: s = v t_r + v^2 / (2 mu g)

t_r.description: delay before full braking (reaction and brake build-up)

assumptions: all wheels braked at the friction limit (no lock-up loss, no ABS cycling)
level road
constant friction
formulas.source: constant deceleration kinematics (textbook)

formulas.title: ブレーキで前に移る荷重と、後輪が浮く減速度
formulas.expression: W_front = m g (L - a)/L + m a_x h / L; W_rear = m g a / L - m a_x h / L; a_x_tip = a / h

a.description: distance from the front axle back to the centre of gravity

h.description: height of the centre of gravity

W_rear.description: rear axle load while braking (lifts at 0)

a_x_tip.description: deceleration at which the rear wheels lift (forward tip)

assumptions: rigid body, level road
pitch from the springs ignored
formulas.source: moment balance about the front contact line (textbook vehicle dynamics)

formulas.title: 坂に上り向きで止まっているのに要る摩擦係数 (全輪・後輪だけ・前輪だけのブレーキ)
formulas.expression: theta = atan(grade); mu_all = tan(theta); mu_rear = sin(theta) L / (a cos(theta) + h sin(theta)); mu_front = sin(theta) L / ((L - a) cos(theta) - h sin(theta))

a.description: distance from the front axle back to the centre of gravity

h.description: height of the centre of gravity

mu_all.description: friction needed with all wheels braked

mu_rear.description: friction needed with the rear wheels braked only

mu_front.description: friction needed with the front wheels braked only

assumptions: rigid body standing still, facing uphill
the braked wheels hold the whole slope force
the mass cancels out
formulas.source: force and moment balance on a slope (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 止まった所から目標の速さまでの時間と最高速度
formulas.expression: t = integral lambda m dv / (F(v) - R(v)); F(v) = min(F_max, eta P / v); R(v) = m g (C_rr cos + sin) + 1/2 rho C_d A v^2

F_max.description: largest tractive force at the wheels (torque limit)

eta.description: efficiency from motor shaft to wheels

lambda.description: mass factor for rotating parts (1 = none)

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

t.description: time from standstill to the target speed

assumptions: full drive force from standstill, no wheel spin (traction not checked)
drive force torque-limited, then power-limited
steady grade, no wind
formulas.source: Newton's second law integrated over speed (textbook vehicle performance)

formulas.title: 出力で決まる最高速度
formulas.expression: eta P = (m g (C_rr cos + sin) + 1/2 rho C_d A v^2) v, solved for v

eta.description: efficiency from motor shaft to wheels

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

v_top.description: top speed (motor speed limits not included)

F.description: tractive force at top speed

assumptions: power-limited at top speed
motor and gear speed limits not included
steady grade, no wind
formulas.source: power balance eta P = road load times speed (textbook vehicle performance)

formulas.title: 周回を走る電力量 (電力 × 時間の和)
formulas.expression: E = [(m g C_rr + 1/2 rho C_d A v^2) d + m g H] / eta - eta_regen m g H

H.description: total height climbed over the distance (the loop comes back down as much)

eta_regen.description: share of the descent's potential energy returned to the battery (0 without regeneration)

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

range.description: distance the battery lasts at this rate

assumptions: constant speed, accelerations ignored
small grades (cos = 1)
the descent returns eta_regen of its potential energy, after nothing else
no auxiliary loads
formulas.source: sum of resistance work over the distance (textbook vehicle performance)

formulas.title: 一定の速さ・坂で走るときの電池の電力
formulas.expression: P = (m g (C_rr cos(theta) + sin(theta)) + 1/2 rho C_d A v^2) v / eta; theta = atan(grade)

grade.description: road grade (rise over run, uphill positive)

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

F.description: tractive force at the wheels

assumptions: steady speed
no auxiliary loads
driving (not regenerating)
formulas.source: road load times speed (textbook vehicle performance)

formulas.title: 損失 × 熱抵抗で出す定常の温度
formulas.expression: T = T_amb + P R

P.description: heat loss in the part (mean over the use)

R.description: thermal resistance from the part to the air

dT.description: temperature rise above the air (a difference)

assumptions: one lumped temperature per part
steady state (long use)
constant thermal resistance
formulas.source: lumped thermal resistance (textbook heat transfer)

formulas.title: 一定の損失をかけたときの温度の上がり方 (熱容量と熱抵抗)
formulas.expression: T(t) = T_amb + P R (1 - exp(-t/tau)); tau = R C

R.description: thermal resistance from the part to the air

dT.description: temperature rise above the air at time t (a difference)

assumptions: one lumped temperature per part
constant loss from t = 0
starts at the air temperature
formulas.source: first-order RC thermal network step response (textbook heat transfer)

formulas.title: 効率から出す損失
formulas.expression: P_loss = P_out (1/eta - 1)
assumptions: all losses become heat in the part
formulas.source: energy balance (textbook)

formulas.title: 走ったあとの電池の残量
formulas.expression: soc_end = soc_start - E / E_batt

soc_start.description: state of charge at the start

soc_end.description: state of charge at the end (below 0: the battery runs out first)

assumptions: the usable energy is the nominal voltage times the capacity
formulas.source: energy balance (arithmetic)

formulas.title: 林道の周回を一定の速さで走るとみたときの、電池・モーター・制御器の損失と温度
formulas.expression: per section: F = m g (C_rr cos(th) + sin(th)) + rho C_d A v^2 / 2, P = F v through the efficiency chain, (V - R_b I) I = P_batt; losses averaged over the time t; T = T_amb + P_loss R (1 - exp(-t / (R C)))

rho.description: air density (1.225 at sea level and 15 degC in the Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere, ICAO Doc 7488; not checked in this repository)

eta_regen.description: share of the braking power at the wheels returned to the battery

d.description: distance driven round the 2 km forest loop

grade_low.description: grade of the gentle climb and descent

grade_high.description: grade of the steep climb and descent

T_amb.description: air temperature (and the parts' starting temperature)

R_battery.description: thermal resistance from the battery to the air

R_motor.description: thermal resistance from the motor to the air

R_controller.description: thermal resistance from the controller to the air

t.description: time round the loop at the target speeds

P_battery.description: mean heat loss in the battery

T_battery.description: temperature of the battery at the end of the drive

P_motor.description: mean heat loss in the motor

T_motor.description: temperature of the motor at the end of the drive

P_controller.description: mean heat loss in the controller

T_controller.description: temperature of the controller at the end of the drive

assumptions: each section is driven at its target speed (no accelerating or braking)
the loop of the K3 drive (2 km laps: flat, gentle and steep climbs and descents)
each part is one lumped temperature with a constant mean loss, so the end is its warmest
formulas.source: road load times speed (textbook vehicle performance) and a first-order RC thermal network (textbook heat transfer)

formulas.title: 線形のばねで壁に当たったときの最大の減速度とつぶれ
formulas.expression: a_max = v sqrt(k/m); x_max = v sqrt(m/k); t_stop = (pi/2) sqrt(m/k); E = m v^2 / 2

m.description: mass of the vehicle with its load

k.description: stiffness of the front against the wall

E.description: kinetic energy taken by the front

assumptions: one mass on one linear spring
rigid wall
no damping, no rebound counted
formulas.source: undamped mass-spring impact, a quarter period of free vibration (textbook dynamics)

formulas.title: 壁に当たってつぶれたあと、乗員の前に残る長さ
formulas.expression: margin = s - x_max; x_max = v sqrt(m/k)

m.description: mass of the vehicle with its load

k.description: stiffness of the front against the wall

s.description: length from the front of the vehicle back to the occupants' front

margin.description: length left in front of the occupants (negative: the crush reaches them)

assumptions: one mass on one linear spring
rigid wall
the crush takes the length from the front back
formulas.source: undamped mass-spring impact (textbook dynamics) and a difference of lengths

formulas.title: つぶれる距離から出す平均の減速度
formulas.expression: a_mean = v^2 / (2 s); F_mean = m a_mean; E = m v^2 / 2

m.description: mass of the vehicle with its load

E.description: kinetic energy taken by the front

assumptions: constant deceleration over the crush distance
rigid wall
formulas.source: work-energy: F s = m v^2 / 2 (textbook dynamics)

formulas.title: 角パイプが折れ畳まれてつぶれるときの平均の力

sigma_0.description: flow stress: (yield + tensile)/2, or the yield stress without a tensile strength

n.description: number of such tubes crushing side by side

F_m.description: mean crushing force of the n tubes

assumptions: progressive folding of a thin-walled tube under an axial load (no global bending)
rigid-perfectly plastic material at the flow stress
the tubes crush side by side: forces add
formulas.source: Wierzbicki & Abramowicz (1983), J. Appl. Mech. 50: P_m = 9.56 sigma_0 t^(5/3) C^(1/3), C = (b + h) / 2 (not checked)

formulas.title: 丸パイプが折れ畳まれてつぶれるときの平均の力
formulas.expression: F_m = n 6 sigma_0 t^1.5 sqrt(d - t)

sigma_0.description: flow stress: (yield + tensile)/2, or the yield stress without a tensile strength

n.description: number of such tubes crushing side by side

F_m.description: mean crushing force of the n tubes

assumptions: axisymmetric progressive folding of a thin-walled tube (no global bending)
rigid-perfectly plastic material at the flow stress
D in the source is the mean diameter d - t
formulas.source: Alexander (1960), Q. J. Mech. Appl. Math. 13: P_m = 6 sigma_0 t^1.5 sqrt(D), D the mean diameter (not checked)

formulas.title: バンパーのばねのあと、つぶれる所が平均の力で塑性でつぶれるときのつぶれと減速度 (エネルギーの釣り合い)
formulas.expression: E = m v^2/2; E_b = k_b stroke^2/2; s = (E - E_b)/F_m; x_max = stroke + s; a_max = a_mean = F_m/m; t_stop = asin(w stroke/v)/w + m sqrt(v^2 - k_b stroke^2/m)/F_m, w = sqrt(k_b/m)

m.description: mass of the vehicle with its load

F_m.description: mean crushing force of the crush zone (sum over the rails)

x_max.description: largest crush of the front (bumper stroke + crush)

a_mean.description: deceleration while the crush zone folds

a_max.description: largest deceleration (the folding force; no first peak counted)

E.description: kinetic energy taken by the front

E_b.description: elastic energy left in the bumper

assumptions: the body is rigid; the bumper is a linear spring up to its stroke, then the crush zone folds at its mean force F_m (rigid-plastic, no spring back)
the bumper bottoms out before the crush zone folds (k_b stroke <= F_m)
the crush stays within the usable crush length (no hard stop)
rigid wall
formulas.source: work-energy F_m s = m v^2/2 - E_b and the motion in two pieces (a quarter of a harmonic arc, then constant deceleration) (textbook dynamics)

formulas.title: 塑性でつぶれたあと、乗員の前に残る長さ
formulas.expression: margin = s - x_max; x_max = stroke + (m v^2/2 - k_b stroke^2/2) / F_m

m.description: mass of the vehicle with its load

F_m.description: mean crushing force of the crush zone (sum over the rails)

s.description: length from the front of the vehicle back to the occupants' front

margin.description: length left in front of the occupants (negative: the crush reaches them)

assumptions: the body is rigid; the bumper is a linear spring up to its stroke, then the crush zone folds at its mean force F_m (rigid-plastic, no spring back)
the bumper bottoms out before the crush zone folds (k_b stroke <= F_m)
the crush stays within the usable crush length (no hard stop)
rigid wall
the crush takes the length from the front back
formulas.source: work-energy F_m s = m v^2/2 - E_b (textbook dynamics) and a difference of lengths

formulas.title: つぶれる所の後ろのレールが、つぶれの力で折れるか (まっすぐな柱として)
formulas.expression: P_c = min(A f_y, pi^2 E I / L^2); u = F / P_c; fraction = share when u >= 1, else 0

F.description: force one rail passes back while the crush zone folds (its mean crushing force)

A.description: wall area of the rail behind the crush zone

I.description: the rail's smaller second moment of area

L.description: length of the rail from the crush zone's end back to the occupants (pinned ends)

share.description: share of the whole mass ahead of the crush zone's end (what comes off if the rail folds)

fraction.description: share of the mass broken off the frame (0: the rails hold)

u.description: the rail's load over its collapse load

P_c.description: collapse load of the rail: squash or Euler buckling, the smaller

assumptions: the rail behind the crush zone is a straight column with pinned ends, loaded along its axis by the crush zone's mean crushing force
no bending from the towers or the arm brackets on it
a rail that collapses lets the front (ahead of the crush zone's end) come off
formulas.source: squash load A f_y and Euler's buckling load pi^2 E I / L^2 (textbook strength of materials)

formulas.title: ばねと質量の固有振動数
formulas.expression: f = sqrt(k/m) / (2 pi)
assumptions: one degree of freedom
linear spring, no damping
formulas.source: single degree of freedom oscillator (textbook vibration)

formulas.title: 1/4 車両の上下の固有振動数 (乗り心地の振動数)
formulas.expression: k_ride = k_s k_t / (k_s + k_t); f = sqrt(k_ride / m_s) / (2 pi)

f.description: body bounce frequency of the corner

k_ride.description: ride rate (suspension and tyre in series)

assumptions: unsprung mass small next to the sprung mass
linear springs, no damping
formulas.source: quarter-car model, springs in series (textbook vehicle dynamics)

formulas.title: 両端を支えた角パイプの梁の 1 次の曲げの固有振動数
formulas.expression: f1 = (pi / (2 L^2)) sqrt(E I / (rho A))

h.description: tube height (in the plane of vibration)

assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam, simply supported
the beam's own mass only (no added masses)
bending in the plane of h
formulas.source: first mode of a simply supported uniform beam (textbook vibration)

formulas.title: はしご形のフレームのねじりの固有振動数 (左右のレールが逆に動くモード)
formulas.expression: psi = psi' (x - x_I); K = 2 G J_r L + n_c G J_c w + sum over wheels k (t/2)^2 d^2; f = sqrt(K / (I0 r_x^2)) / (2 pi) (Rayleigh)

J_r.description: torsion constant of a rail (Bredt for a tube)

J_c.description: torsion constant of a cross member

w.description: distance between the rails (length of a cross member)

I0.description: roll inertia of everything on the frame about the vehicle's x axis

r_x.description: spread of that roll inertia along x (radius of gyration about its centroid x_I)

d_r.description: rear axle ahead of x_I (negative behind)

f.description: first twist frequency of the frame

spring_share.description: share of the suspension springs in the twist stiffness

assumptions: the twist angle varies linearly along x about the roll inertia's centroid (a Rayleigh upper bound)
rails and cross members twist (Bredt), joints rigid; the rails' opposite bending is left out
the weights sit on the frame nodes that carry them; the suspension springs are vertical
formulas.source: Rayleigh's method for the lowest mode; Saint-Venant torsion of thin-walled closed tubes (Bredt) (textbook vibration and structures)

formulas.title: 両端を支えた丸パイプの軸 (ドライブシャフト) の 1 次の曲げの固有振動数
assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli beam, held across at both joints and free to turn there (simply supported)
the tube's own mass only (the joints' mass sits at the supports)
formulas.source: first mode of a simply supported uniform beam (textbook vibration)

formulas.title: 2 つの回る質量を軸のねじりでつないだ固有振動数 (モーターと減速機・車輪とドライブシャフト)

J_1.description: turning inertia at one end (motor and reducer as seen at this shaft)

J_2.description: turning inertia at the other end (the wheel)

f.description: torsion frequency of the two inertias on the shaft

k.description: torsion stiffness of the shaft (torque per radian of twist)

assumptions: the shaft's own turning inertia is left out (small next to the two ends)
both ends turn free (no grip of the tyre on the road)
formulas.source: two-disc torsional vibration on a massless shaft; Saint-Venant torsion of a round tube (textbook vibration)

formulas.title: 車輪とモーターの回転で揺する振動数
formulas.expression: f_wheel = v / (2 pi r); f_motor = i f_wheel

i.description: reduction ratio from motor to wheel

assumptions: no slip
first order of rotation only (imbalance, out-of-round)
formulas.source: kinematics of rolling (textbook)

formulas.title: 1/4 車で見た悪路の疲労の損傷 (静的な応力 × 輪の力のゆれ、レイリー分布の繰り返し)
formulas.expression: sigma_F^2 = integral |H_F(f)|^2 G_z(f) df (quarter car, G_d(n) = G_d(n0) (n/n0)^-2); sigma_s = sigma_w sigma_F / W; nu0 = sqrt(m2/m0); D = nu0 (d/v) E[1/N(2a)], a ~ Rayleigh(sigma_s); N: slope m above the knee, 2 m - 1 below

sigma_w.description: stress at the weld under the wheel's static load

zeta.description: damping ratio of the sprung mass on that spring

G_d.description: road displacement PSD at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m (ISO 8608 class)

FAT.description: fatigue class: stress range at 2e6 cycles

N_knee.description: cycles at the knee of the curve

D.description: Miner damage over the distance (failure at 1)

sigma_s.description: spread (standard deviation) of the weld stress

sigma_F.description: spread of the dynamic tyre force

n.description: number of load cycles over the distance

assumptions: one wheel as a linear quarter car; the weld stress follows that wheel's force in proportion to its static stress
the other wheels and the body's pitch are left out
narrow-band cycles: Rayleigh amplitudes at the mean crossing rate

IIW-type S-N curve and Miner's rule, no mean stress correction; below the knee the curve goes on with slope 2 m - 1 (IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 4.3.1, p.110, for Miner summation of a spectrum); the design's slope after the knee (constant amplitude) is not used
formulas.source: random vibration of a linear system (textbook): output spread from the frequency response and the input spectrum; narrow-band Miner damage of Rayleigh cycles (textbook fatigue); the road spectrum form of ISO 8608 (not checked in this repository); the S-N curve of the IIW recommendations: m, the knee and the slope 2 m - 1 below it for a spectrum as in IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 3.2 and 4.3.1, pp.42 and 110, read there by the quality department; the 2016 edition (A. F. Hobbacher, 2nd ed., Springer) not checked

formulas.title: 4 輪の 1/4 車で見た悪路の疲労の損傷 (輪ごとの 1 kN あたりの応力、左右は別の道、後ろは前と同じ道)
formulas.expression: S_sigma(f) = sum over the two tracks |sigma_f H_f(f) + sigma_r H_r(f) exp(-2 pi i f L / v)|^2 G_z(f) (H: quarter-car tyre force per road height, G_d(n) = G_d(n0) (n/n0)^-2); sigma_s^2 = m0, nu0 = sqrt(m2/m0); D = nu0 (d/v) E[1/N(2a)], a ~ Rayleigh(sigma_s); N: slope m above the knee, 2 m - 1 below

sigma_ra.description: weld stress for 1 kN up at rear wheel a

sigma_rb.description: weld stress for 1 kN up at rear wheel b

sigma_fa.description: weld stress for 1 kN up at front wheel a (the track of rear a)

sigma_fb.description: weld stress for 1 kN up at front wheel b

W_f.description: static load of a front wheel

m_uf.description: unsprung mass of a front wheel

k_sf.description: wheel rate of a front suspension

zeta_f.description: damping ratio of the sprung mass on a front spring

W_r.description: static load of a rear wheel

m_ur.description: unsprung mass of a rear wheel

k_sr.description: wheel rate of a rear suspension

zeta_r.description: damping ratio of the sprung mass on a rear spring

L.description: wheelbase (the rear wheel meets the front wheel's road L / v later)

G_d.description: road displacement PSD at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m (ISO 8608 class)

FAT.description: fatigue class: stress range at 2e6 cycles

N_knee.description: cycles at the knee of the curve

D.description: Miner damage over the distance (failure at 1)

sigma_s.description: spread (standard deviation) of the weld stress

n.description: number of load cycles over the distance

assumptions: each wheel a linear quarter car; the weld stress is linear in the four dynamic tyre forces
left and right tracks independent; the rear wheel runs on the front wheel's track
the two sides' quarter cars alike (one set of front and one of rear values)
narrow-band cycles: Rayleigh amplitudes at the mean crossing rate (more damage than rainflow counting gives for a broad-band stress)

IIW-type S-N curve and Miner's rule, no mean stress correction; below the knee the curve goes on with slope 2 m - 1 (IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 4.3.1, p.110, for Miner summation of a spectrum); the design's slope after the knee (constant amplitude) is not used
formulas.source: random vibration of linear systems (textbook): output spread from the frequency responses, the input spectrum and the lag between the axles; narrow-band Miner damage of Rayleigh cycles (textbook fatigue); the road spectrum form of ISO 8608 (not checked in this repository); the S-N curve of the IIW recommendations: m, the knee and the slope 2 m - 1 below it for a spectrum as in IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 3.2 and 4.3.1, pp.42 and 110, read there by the quality department; the 2016 edition (A. F. Hobbacher, 2nd ed., Springer) not checked

formulas.title: 一定の応力の幅をくり返したときの疲労の損傷 (マイナー則)
formulas.expression: N = 2e6 (FAT / dS)^m above the knee, N_knee (dS_knee / dS)^m2 below; D = n / N

FAT.description: fatigue class: stress range at 2e6 cycles

N_knee.description: cycles at the knee of the curve

m2.description: slope beyond the knee for constant amplitude (not for a spectrum: there IIW uses 2 m - 1)

N.description: cycles to failure at this range

assumptions: constant stress range
IIW-type S-N curve for welded joints (no mean stress correction)
linear damage accumulation (Miner)

m2 is the slope below the knee for constant amplitude (IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 3.2, p.44, for very high cycles); for a stress spectrum IIW continues the curve with 2 m - 1 (sec. 4.3.1, p.110), as the road formulas do
formulas.source: S-N curve N = 2e6 (FAT / range)^m and Miner's rule: A. F. Hobbacher, Recommendations for Fatigue Design of Welded Joints and Components, 2nd ed., Springer 2016 (IIW document IIW-2259-15); not checked in this repository

formulas.title: 走る距離で受ける荷重のくり返しの回数
formulas.expression: n = f d / v

f.description: frequency of the dominant load swing (e.g. body bounce or wheel hop)

assumptions: one load cycle per period of the dominant frequency
constant speed
formulas.source: cycles = frequency x time (arithmetic)

formulas.title: 組み立てる部品の数 (どれも入れられるなら、組み立ての手順の数)
formulas.expression: steps = n - n_out

n_out.description: parts that are not assembled (occupants, cargo)

steps.description: assembly steps if every part can go in

assumptions: one step per part
every part can be put in along some direction
formulas.source: counting

formulas.title: 止まっているときに重なっている物の組の数 (軸に揃えた箱で数える)
formulas.expression: n = n_rest + n_slide

n_rest.description: pairs of boxes overlapping at rest by more than the rule allows

n_slide.description: pairs with the driver's seat moved to either end of its slide

assumptions: parts not turned (no rpy_deg) as their boxes, members along x, y or z as the box of their length and section; turned parts and slanted members left out (their axis-aligned box is far bigger than they are), so an overlap of one of them can be missed, never added
two boxes overlap by the smallest of their overlaps along x, y and z
what may overlap how far is the tool's rule (k4_geometry.model.allowance): the definition of an interference, not a calculation
formulas.source: counting (assembly_inputs.overlap_inputs)

formulas.title: 車輪が上下しハンドルを切ったときに当たる物の組の数 (車輪の箱とタイロッドの棒で数える)
formulas.expression: n = n_wheel + n_rod

n_wheel.description: pairs of a wheel (its box turned through the steering's range every 1 deg, its height range grown by the travel) and a box

n_rod.description: pairs of a tie rod (a straight rod of its section's radius, the inner end in place, the outer end with the wheel) and a box

assumptions: only the wheels and the tie rods move (the tool also moves the knuckle, the brake and the other links of the corner)
the wheel turns about the vertical axis through the support's position, through -max_steer_angle to +max_steer_angle; it moves up and down by half the travel each way
the other bodies as in assembly.overlap_count (turned parts and slanted members left out); what is mounted to the moving part is the tool's rule (k4_geometry.model.mounted)
formulas.source: plane geometry of a turned rectangle and of a line (assembly_inputs.motion_inputs)

formulas.title: 6 方向のどれからも入らない部品の数 (枠と溶接の物だけを相手に)
formulas.expression: n = n_blocked

n_blocked.description: parts whose box pushed along +-x, +-y and +-z meets the frame every way

assumptions: only the frame stops a part: its members and the welded pieces (kinds frame, gusset, rollbar, bracket), there before any part; parts put in earlier are not counted (the tool also tries orders, and slides a part first)
a part goes straight along one axis; a piece already overlapping it at rest is H1-interference's and does not stop it
boxes as in assembly.overlap_count; turned parts are not counted
formulas.source: counting (assembly_inputs.blocked_inputs)

formulas.title: 触れていないつながりと、どこにもつながらない部品の数 (箱で測る)
formulas.expression: n = n_gap + n_none

n_gap.description: mechanical connects_to (not wire or hose) whose ends are more than 2 mm apart

n.description: joints that do not touch, and parts joined to nothing

assumptions: the gap between the axis-aligned boxes round the two (a node's or a support's point for those): never more than the gap between the shapes, so a joint can be missed, never added
a joint touches when the gap is at most 2 mm; wires and hoses run between the two and are not counted
formulas.source: counting (assembly_inputs.joint_inputs)

formulas.title: モジュールの空間からはみ出した部品と部材の数 (軸に揃えた箱で)
formulas.expression: n = n_out

n_out.description: parts and members whose box is not inside one box of their module's envelope

assumptions: each body as the axis-aligned box round it (turned parts round their turned corners, slanted members round their ends widened by half the section's largest side)
inside means inside one box of the envelope, more than 0.5 mm out counts
formulas.source: counting (assembly_inputs.envelope_inputs)

formulas.title: ハンドルを切ったとき、車輪の内側の角がフレームに当たるまでの角度
formulas.expression: w cos(theta) + l sin(theta) - w = c  ->  theta = asin((w + c) / sqrt(w^2 + l^2)) - atan2(w, l)

l.description: half the tyre length in plan view (the wheel radius)

c.description: room between the tyre's inner face and the frame beside it

theta.description: steer angle at which the inner corner reaches the frame (90 if never)

assumptions: the wheel is a rectangle in plan view (diameter x width)
it turns about the vertical axis through its centre
the frame face beside it runs along x
formulas.source: plane geometry of a rotated rectangle

formulas.title: ハンドルの止め (max_steer_angle) までで、車輪がフレームに当たらずに切れる角度
formulas.expression: theta = min(theta_free, theta_stop)

theta_free.description: steer angle at which the wheel reaches the frame (geometry.free_steer_angle)

theta.description: steer angle reached without touching the frame

assumptions: the steering stops at theta_stop: the wheel is not turned further, so the angle checked is not larger than it
formulas.source: definition (the smaller of two angles)

formulas.title: ペダルを踏む脚の膝の角度が、運転の姿勢の楽な範囲にあるか (腰から足首までの長さで)
formulas.expression: d(theta) = sqrt(l1^2 + l2^2 - 2 l1 l2 cos theta); for each body size: min(d(theta) - d(theta_lo), d(theta_hi) - d(theta)); room = the smaller of the two

l1_big.description: hip to knee (thigh) of the large (male 95th percentile) person's leg

l2_big.description: knee to ankle (shank) of the large (male 95th percentile) person's leg

theta_big.description: knee angle (between thigh and shank) as seated of the large (male 95th percentile) person's leg

l1_small.description: hip to knee (thigh) of the small (female 5th percentile) person's leg

l2_small.description: knee to ankle (shank) of the small (female 5th percentile) person's leg

theta_small.description: knee angle (between thigh and shank) as seated of the small (female 5th percentile) person's leg

room.description: the smaller margin of the two people (negative: a knee out of the range)

assumptions: the leg is two straight links hinged at the knee (side view); the hip-ankle distance grows with the knee angle, so a margin is negative exactly when the angle is out of the range
the knee angles are those of K4's seated poses (each person at their best place in the seat's slide): not an independent estimate of the angle, only of its margin
formulas.source: law of cosines (geometry); the range from Porter and Gyi 1998 as k4_geometry.people.KNEE_COMFORT_DEG

formulas.title: 座った人の膝の前の余裕
formulas.expression: room = L - L_bk

L.description: from the seat back to the nearest part ahead at knee height

room.description: room in front of the knees (negative: the knees hit)

assumptions: the person sits against the seat back
thighs level, along x
formulas.source: difference of lengths (geometry)

formulas.title: ダブルウィッシュボーンのロールセンターの高さ (正面から見た瞬間中心の作図)
formulas.expression: IC = (lower arm line) x (upper arm line); h_rc = z_c + (0 - y_c) (z_IC - z_c) / (y_IC - y_c)

y_li.description: lower arm inner pivot, y (front view, the vehicle's centre line at y = 0, the ground at z = 0)

h_rc.description: roll centre height above the ground at the design travel

assumptions: the arms' pivot axes run along x, so the front view shows each arm as a line
small motion about the design travel
the tyre is rigid at the contact point
formulas.source: kinematics of a planar four-bar: the contact point moves about the arms' instant centre, so the body rolls about where that line crosses the centre line

formulas.title: セルフアライニングトルクで、タイロッドが伸びて車輪が向きを変える角度 (左の輪、トーイン +)
formulas.expression: theta = M (k . z) / (k_t a^2) about the kingpin axis k; toe = -theta (k . z)  (M about +z)

M.description: aligning moment about the vertical, + turns the wheel's nose to the left

k_z.description: vertical component of the unit kingpin axis (lower to upper ball joint)

a.description: arm of the tie rod's force about the kingpin axis

k_t.description: tie rod stiffness along its length

toe.description: toe change of a left wheel (toe-in +)

assumptions: only the tie rod gives way: the arm bushings and ball joints are stiff
the knuckle turns about the kingpin axis through the ball joints
small angles
formulas.source: statics of the knuckle about the kingpin axis: the moment's component M (k . z) is held by the tie rod force F a, which stretches the rod F / k_t = theta a
