Tp_b.description: plastic torque of the top beam (2 A_m t f_y / sqrt 3, thin closed tube)

A_o.description: area of an outrigger (unused when e = 0)

Iy_o.description: second moment of an outrigger (unused when e = 0) about its local y axis (K1 axes: bending about the vertical (horizontal bending))

Iz_o.description: second moment of an outrigger (unused when e = 0) about its local z axis (K1 axes: bending vertical bending)

J_o.description: torsion constant of an outrigger (unused when e = 0)

Mpy_o.description: plastic moment of an outrigger (unused when e = 0) about its local y axis (Z_p f_y)

Mpz_o.description: plastic moment of an outrigger (unused when e = 0) about its local z axis (Z_p f_y)

Tp_o.description: plastic torque of an outrigger (unused when e = 0) (2 A_m t f_y / sqrt 3, thin closed tube)

A_r.description: area of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0)

Iy_r.description: second moment of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0) about its local y axis (K1 axes: bending about the vertical (horizontal bending))

Iz_r.description: second moment of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0) about its local z axis (K1 axes: bending vertical bending)

J_r.description: torsion constant of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0)

Mpy_r.description: plastic moment of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0) about its local y axis (Z_p f_y)

Mpz_r.description: plastic moment of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0) about its local z axis (Z_p f_y)

Tp_r.description: plastic torque of the rail at the foot (unused when L_a = L_b = 0) (2 A_m t f_y / sqrt 3, thin closed tube)

f_y.description: yield stress of the posts (for the squash load)

F.description: crushing force down at the middle of the top beam (R4: the load case's crush_force)

delta.description: deflection down at the middle of the top beam at F (h when the frame collapses below F)

delta_at_F_or_collapse.description: deflection at F, or when the mechanism forms if that is below F

F_first.description: load at the first plastic hinge

collapsed.description: 1: F is above the collapse load

F_euler.description: both posts' Euler load as cantilevers (K = 2, the safe side)

n_hinges.description: hinges formed up to the mechanism

assumptions: the crushing force acts down at the middle of the top beam, in the portal's plane

the roll bar alone: two equal upright posts, a straight top beam and rigid corners; each foot on an outrigger of length e across the vehicle (none when e = 0) from a rail along the vehicle, the rail held fixed at L_a ahead and L_b behind the outrigger's root (frame_inputs.portal_frame_inputs: where the chassis is held on its wheels; the cross members, the other rail and the rest of the chassis between are left out, which makes the feet softer)
slender 3D beams (no shear deformation), small displacements (no change of geometry)

plastic hinges at member ends when the moment about one bending axis reaches Z_p f_y or the torque reaches the plastic torque; capacities independent (no interaction of bending, torsion and axial force), no unloading of hinges, no strain hardening; once a mechanism, the load stays at the collapse load along the mechanism's shape

a collapse below F is given as delta = h (unbounded in small-deflection theory; the corners taken down a post's length, the end of the crushing motion of rops_inputs); the posts' squash and buckling loads are given to compare, not in the path
formulas.source: matrix stiffness (slope-deflection) and step-by-step (event-to-event) plastic analysis of frames, textbook structural analysis (W. McGuire, R. H. Gallagher, R. D. Ziemian, Matrix Structural Analysis; B. G. Neal, The Plastic Methods of Structural Analysis; J. Heyman, Plastic Design of Frames); written out and solved here, the books not re-read for this; no table values

formulas.title: ベッドの床の枠: 上のレール・柱・下のレールの閉じた枠に一様な荷重 (たわみ角法)
formulas.expression: w = W / (a1 + L + a2); FEM = w L^2 / 12; overhang moments w a1^2 / 2, w a2^2 / 2; M_ij = (2 E I / L)(2 th_i + th_j) + FEM_ij for the upper rail, the posts and the base rail; joint equilibrium at the 4 corners (no sway) -> th; sigma = max(M_rail / Z_r, M_post / Z_p + R / A_p)

W.description: load on one upper rail (its share of the deck's load and the rail's own weight)

L.description: post to post along the rail

h.description: post length, base rail centre to upper rail centre

sigma.description: largest bending stress of the rail and the posts (the larger)

sigma_post.description: post's largest bending plus axial stress

assumptions: the load is uniform along the upper rail (the weights spread along the deck)
one side of the bed as a plane frame: the cross members and the other side are left out
joints rigid, no sway of the posts
Euler-Bernoulli beams, bending only (the posts' axial stress added)
formulas.source: slope-deflection method for rigid plane frames (textbook structural analysis)

formulas.title: 背上げ・膝上げのアクチュエーターの力 (板をちょうつがいのまわりに起こす腕)
formulas.expression: M(theta) = M0 cos(theta); tip = r (sin theta, -cos theta); anchor (-a_x, -a_z); d = |tip x e|, e the unit vector anchor -> tip; F = M / d, the largest over 0 .. theta_max; stroke = |tip(theta_max) - anchor| - |tip(0) - anchor|

M0.description: moment of the board and its load about the hinge, flat

r.description: lever length (hinge to the actuator's pin, at right angles to the board)

a_x.description: anchor's distance from the hinge along the frame, on the side the actuator pushes from

F_max.description: largest actuator force over the raise

theta_at_max.description: raise angle of the largest force

F_flat.description: actuator force at the flat position (start of the raise)

stroke.description: actuator stroke used for the raise

length_flat.description: pin-to-pin length at the flat position

assumptions: quasi-static (no acceleration, no friction in the hinge and the pins)
the load stays where it is on the board as it rises (it turns with the board)
scanned at 721 angles
formulas.source: moment balance of a lever about its hinge (textbook statics)

formulas.title: ベッドの側端に下向きの力をかけたときの、反対側のキャスターに残る力 (倒れ)
formulas.expression: R_far = (W (y_s - y_cg) - F (y_F - y_s)) / (2 y_s); R_near = W + F - R_far

W.description: weight of the bed and what is on it (without the edge load)

y_cg.description: centre of gravity's offset toward the loaded side

F.description: edge load, straight down

y_F.description: edge load's offset from the centre line, on the loaded side

y_s.description: caster line's offset from the centre line (half the caster track)

R_far.description: load left on the casters of the far side (both together); below 0 the bed tips

R_near.description: load on the casters of the loaded side (both together)

assumptions: rigid bed on a level floor; the casters' contact points on two lines along the bed
the load and the weight act straight down
formulas.source: moment balance about the loaded side's caster line (textbook statics)

formulas.title: サイドレールの上の棒の真ん中を外へ押したときの柱 (差し込みの筒・ガセット)、受け口、棒の曲げ
formulas.expression: top bar = beam (E I, G J of d, t; bending in the level plane and twist) on n posts at 0, u2, u3, S; push F at S / 2; each post a stepped cantilever (tip force R and moment M against deflection and rotation: flexibilities sum over the steps of (H - z)^2, (H - z), 1 over E I_step) and a torsion spring k_t = 1 / sum(dz / (G J_step)); the foot's turn (R H + M) / k_f adds H^2 / k_f, H / k_f, 1 / k_f to the flexibilities; stiffness method -> R_i, M_i, T_i; sigma_post = max over posts and steps sqrt(((R_i (H - z0) + M_i) c / I)^2 + 3 (T_i tau_per_T)^2); sigma_socket = R / A_k + (|R H + M| + |T|) / Z_k; sigma_bar = the bar's largest moment / Z; sigma = the largest

F.description: outward push at the top bar's middle

H.description: post length, socket's centre line to the top bar

S.description: top bar span, end post to end post

u2.description: second post from the head-end post (n >= 3; else not used)

u3.description: third post from the head-end post (n = 4; else not used)

s.description: sleeve the post is inserted in: its length up from the socket (0: none)

t_s.description: sleeve wall (its inside diameter is d)

g.description: gusset's leg up the post (0: none)

k_f1.description: post 1's foot (head to foot): the upper rail's stiffness against its turn in the push's plane, per radian (0: held rigid; not used past n)

k_f2.description: post 2's foot (head to foot): the upper rail's stiffness against its turn in the push's plane, per radian (0: held rigid; not used past n)

k_f3.description: post 3's foot (head to foot): the upper rail's stiffness against its turn in the push's plane, per radian (0: held rigid; not used past n)

k_f4.description: post 4's foot (head to foot): the upper rail's stiffness against its turn in the push's plane, per radian (0: held rigid; not used past n)

sigma.description: the largest of the posts', the sockets' and the bar's

sigma_post.description: posts' von Mises (bending in the push's plane and the torque's shear)

sigma_socket.description: socket stubs' (the post's foot moment and torque, and its force along the stub)

k_post.description: each post's stiffness along the push at its top

k_end.description: each post's torsional stiffness at its top, per radian

assumptions: the posts are cantilevers from their sockets; each foot turns with the upper rail's twist (k_f, given) and the socket stub itself does not bend
the top bar is held by the posts along the push, about the vertical axis (the posts' torsion) and in its twist (the posts' tips turning in the push's plane, against the bar's torsion)
in the sleeve the post and the sleeve bend and twist together as one tube (no gap between them)

the gusset: two plates flanking the post, as deep as the tube at the root, tapering to nothing at g; taken in 4 steps at each step's middle depth, checked at each step's lower end; its shear in torsion taken in the tube alone
the socket stub: square tube along the push, its stress at its end (no length effect)
formulas.source: cantilever bending, torsion of a round tube (J = 2 I), Euler-Bernoulli beam on springs by the stiffness method (textbook)

formulas.title: サイドレールを外へ押したときの、反対側のキャスターに残る力 (倒れ)
formulas.expression: R_far = (W (y_s - y_cg) - F h_F) / (2 y_s); R_near = W - R_far

W.description: weight of the bed and what is on it

y_cg.description: centre of gravity's offset toward the pushed side

F.description: push, level and outward (away from the bed's centre line)

y_s.description: caster line's offset from the centre line (half the caster track)

R_far.description: load left on the casters of the far side (both together); below 0 the bed tips

R_near.description: load on the casters of the pushed side (both together)

assumptions: rigid bed on a level floor; the casters' contact points on two lines along the bed
the casters do not slide: the floor takes the push at the contact points (floor level)
formulas.source: moment balance about the pushed side's caster line (textbook statics), as bed.edge_load_tipping

formulas.title: サイドレールを外へ押したとき、遠い側でいちばん軽いキャスターに残る力 (1 輪でも浮くか)
formulas.expression: s_f = (x_F - x_r) / L_x; W_f = W (x_cg - x_r) / L_x, W_r = W - W_f; R_f = W_f (y_s - y_cg) / (2 y_s) - s_f F h_F / (2 y_s), R_r = W_r (y_s - y_cg) / (2 y_s) - (1 - s_f) F h_F / (2 y_s); R_min = min(R_f, R_r)

W.description: weight of the bed and what is on it

y_cg.description: centre of gravity's offset toward the pushed side

F.description: push, level and outward

y_s.description: caster line's offset from the centre line (half the caster track)

x_cg.description: centre of gravity along the bed

x_r.description: the rear (lower x) casters along the bed

L_x.description: caster base: front casters ahead of the rear ones

R_min.description: load on the lighter caster of the far side; below 0 that caster lifts

R_front.description: load on the far side's front caster

R_rear.description: load on the far side's rear caster

assumptions: rigid in bending, the bed's frame twists: the push's roll moment F h_F goes to the front and rear caster pairs as a torque on a shaft held at both ends, in the shares (x_F - x_r) / L_x and the rest
the weight splits between the pairs by the lever of its centre of gravity, and within a pair by its sideways offset
the casters do not slide (the floor takes the push at the contact points)
a push point outside the caster base is taken at the nearer pair (share 0 or 1)
formulas.source: moment balance about each caster pair's line, with the roll moment split as a point torque on a shaft held at both ends (textbook statics and torsion)

formulas.title: アクチュエーターの金具 (2 枚の耳) の根元の曲げとピンの面圧
formulas.expression: each lug F / 2 at the pin, h_p below its root: sigma_root = (F / 2) h_p / (t w^2 / 6) = 3 F h_p / (t w^2); sigma_bearing = F / (2 d t)

F.description: actuator force along the actuator (horizontal at the flat position)

h_p.description: pin centre below the lug's root (the cross member's underside)

sigma_root.description: bending stress at the lug's root

assumptions: each lug a cantilever from its root, loaded at the pin by half the force
the force is along the lug's width (the actuator lies along x at the flat position)
no hole: the section at the root is the full lug
formulas.source: cantilever bending, bearing pressure on the projected area (textbook machine design)

formulas.title: 高さのアクチュエーターの力
formulas.expression: F = ratio W

W.description: weight on the lift (the upper frame, the deck and its load)

ratio.description: lift linkage's ratio: actuator force per newton on the lift

F.description: lift actuator force

assumptions: the lift linkage's ratio is constant over its travel (the linkage is not modelled)
formulas.source: definition of the ratio (arithmetic)

formulas.title: アクチュエーターの使う割合 (いちばん忙しい 1 時間)
formulas.expression: t_stroke = s / v; on_time = n k t_stroke; duty = on_time / 3600 s

duty.description: share of the hour the actuator runs

on_time.description: time it runs in the hour

assumptions: each stroke at the rated speed
the hour is the busiest one: every use of the day in it
formulas.source: time = stroke / speed (arithmetic)

formulas.title: 使う回数ごとの応力の幅から、溶接の疲労の損傷 (マイナー則。床の枠と 2 つの金具の耳の根元の悪い方)
formulas.expression: N_i = 2e6 (FAT / dS_i)^m above the knee, N_knee (dS_knee / dS_i)^(2m - 1) below; D_i = n_i / N_i; D_frame = D1 + D4, D_lug_back = D2, D_lug_knee = D3, D_worst = the largest; D = sum of the four

D.description: Miner damage of all four uses summed as if at one weld (the safe side)

D_worst.description: damage at the worst weld: the deck frame (uses 1 and 4), the back bracket's lug root (use 2) or the knee bracket's (use 3); failure at 1

D_frame.description: damage at the deck frame (uses 1 and 4)

D_lug_back.description: damage at the back bracket's lug root (use 2)

D_lug_knee.description: damage at the knee bracket's lug root (use 3)

m2.description: slope below the knee used (2 m - 1)

dS_worst.description: stress range at the worst weld (its largest use's; with no damage anywhere, the weld of the largest range): what to compare when the damages are next to 0

assumptions: each use is one cycle of its stress range (0 to the loaded stress)
IIW-type S-N curve (no mean stress correction)
linear damage accumulation (Miner)

the uses' ranges differ, so the cycles are a spectrum: below the knee the slope is 2 m - 1 (IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 4.3.1, p.110; library_fatigue.spectrum_slope), not the constant-amplitude slope of the design variable fatigue_slope_after_knee_constant_amplitude
formulas.source: S-N curve N = 2e6 (FAT / range)^m and Miner's rule: A. F. Hobbacher, Recommendations for Fatigue Design of Welded Joints and Components, 2nd ed., Springer 2016 (IIW), not checked in this repository; the slope 2 m - 1 below the knee for a spectrum: IIW-1823-07 (2008) sec. 4.3.1, p.110 (read in that document by the quality department)

formulas.title: 横・後ろ・上の荷重のそれぞれで、たわんだロールバーと乗員の空間のいちばん近い距離を測り、いちばん小さいもの
formulas.expression: c_side = s_side; c_rear = s_rear; c_top = s_top; rops_occupant_clearance = min(c_side, c_rear, c_top); t_d = g_d - d_d (travel left); requires d_d = d0_d

g_side.description: travel before the side loading (portal_frame_side delta_E), along its motion: the loaded point's travel until the roll bar touches the occupants' space (rops_inputs.rops_gaps; negative when the bar is in it as built)

g_rear.description: travel before the rear loading (portal_frame_rear delta_E), along its motion: the loaded point's travel until the roll bar touches the occupants' space (rops_inputs.rops_gaps; negative when the bar is in it as built)

g_top.description: travel before the crushing (portal_frame_top delta), along its motion: the loaded point's travel until the roll bar touches the occupants' space (rops_inputs.rops_gaps; negative when the bar is in it as built)

d_side.description: deflection of the side loading (portal_frame_side delta_E) at its load point (pred.<quantity> of that prediction)

d_rear.description: deflection of the rear loading (portal_frame_rear delta_E) at its load point (pred.<quantity> of that prediction)

d_top.description: deflection of the crushing (portal_frame_top delta) at its load point (pred.<quantity> of that prediction)

s_side.description: shortest distance between the roll bar and the occupants' space with the bar moved by the side loading (portal_frame_side delta_E)'s motion at d0 (rops_inputs.clearances_at; negative: inside)

s_rear.description: shortest distance between the roll bar and the occupants' space with the bar moved by the rear loading (portal_frame_rear delta_E)'s motion at d0 (rops_inputs.clearances_at; negative: inside)

s_top.description: shortest distance between the roll bar and the occupants' space with the bar moved by the crushing (portal_frame_top delta)'s motion at d0 (rops_inputs.clearances_at; negative: inside)

d0_side.description: deflection of the side loading (portal_frame_side delta_E) the shortest distance was measured at (rops_inputs.portal_deflections)

d0_rear.description: deflection of the rear loading (portal_frame_rear delta_E) the shortest distance was measured at (rops_inputs.portal_deflections)

d0_top.description: deflection of the crushing (portal_frame_top delta) the shortest distance was measured at (rops_inputs.portal_deflections)

rops_occupant_clearance.description: smallest clearance over the three loadings (< 0: the bar enters the occupants' space)

c_side.description: shortest distance after the side loading (s_side)

c_rear.description: shortest distance after the rear loading (s_rear)

t_side.description: travel left along the side motion (g_side - d_side)

t_rear.description: travel left along the rear motion (g_rear - d_rear)

t_top.description: travel left along the crushing motion (g_top - d_top)

governing.description: the loading with the smallest clearance: 1 side, 2 rear, 3 top

assumptions: each loading on its own from the bar as built: the permanent set of one loading is not carried into the next (OECD Code 4 loads in sequence)

the bar moves as its top corners move, the rest of the nodes staying: the posts turn about their feet as straight lines (length kept), the top beam stays straight between the corners (rops_inputs); the bending of the members between their nodes and the feet's own motion are not seen
the rear motion's corner shares are the portal_frame_rear formula's at the rear energy; both senses of each motion are tried (the smaller distance is kept)

the deflection is the portal formula's at its load point (side and rear: at the energy; top: at the crushing force, the posts' length when the frame collapses below it); a deflection past the end of a motion is taken at its end
formulas.source: the R4 load case's criterion (hiraku.catalog.builders.analysis.r4_rops, which cites OECD Code 4, 3.5.2.2, 3.5.3.2 and 3.8: the structure must not enter the clearance zone under each loading; not re-read for this formula); the distances are k4_geometry's capsule-box distance; no table values

formulas.title: はしごがねじれたときの、下の腕の脚の根元の応力 (脚と下の横の部材の U 字、レールのばねの上)
formulas.expression: half U (leg to the pivot, half the lower cross member to the centre line), cut at the centre line with u_x = u_z = rot_y = 0; force method: F R = -u0, F = sum int (N N'/EA + T T'/GJ + M.M'/EI) ds + a a'/k for the rail's springs k_x, k_y, k_z at the base; u0 = the cut moved by the free pitch theta; sigma = N/A +- M_y c_z/I_y +- M_z c_y/I_z at the leg's base; one wheel = half the antisymmetric pair

dx.description: pivot ahead of the leg's rail node (x)

dy.description: pivot beside the leg's rail node (y; negative inboard of the left rail)

dz.description: pivot above the leg's rail node (z; negative below)

y_p.description: pivot's distance from the centre line (half the lower cross member)

k_x.description: the rail's roll against the rest of the ladder at the leg's node (N*mm per rad; frame_inputs.rail_springs)

k_y.description: the rails' opposite pitch (the ladder's warping) at the leg's node (N*mm per rad; frame_inputs.rail_springs)

k_z.description: the rail's yaw against the rest of the ladder at the leg's node (N*mm per rad; frame_inputs.rail_springs)

theta_front.description: pitch (rad) of the left rail at the leg's node in the free ladder (the warping torsion without the U) for 1 kN up at the left and 1 kN down at the right front wheel (frame_inputs.mount_leg_inputs)

theta_rear.description: pitch (rad) of the left rail at the leg's node in the free ladder (the warping torsion without the U) for 1 kN up at the left and 1 kN down at the right rear wheel (frame_inputs.mount_leg_inputs)

sigma_fa.description: stress at the worst corner of the leg's end on the rail for 1 kN up at front wheel a (left)

sigma_fb.description: stress at the worst corner of the leg's end on the rail for 1 kN up at front wheel b (right)

sigma_ra.description: stress at the worst corner of the leg's end on the rail for 1 kN up at rear wheel a (left, the track of front a)

sigma_rb.description: stress at the worst corner of the leg's end on the rail for 1 kN up at rear wheel b

sigma_per_mrad.description: the same stress for 1 mrad of the free ladder's pitch at the node

M_leg_y_per_mrad.description: the leg's base moment about its local y for 1 mrad

M_leg_z_per_mrad.description: the leg's base moment about its local z for 1 mrad

T_cross_per_mrad.description: torque in the lower cross member for 1 mrad

base_turn.description: the rail's pitch at the node with the U on it over the free ladder's

assumptions: the ladder's twist reaches the leg as the opposite pitch of the two rails at the leg's node (warping); the left-right alike half of the wheels' forces (the rails' roll in mirror) is not counted
left and right legs and the lower cross member are mirror images; the cross member runs straight across (y)
the rail under the leg is three springs (roll, pitch, yaw) against the rest of the ladder, uncoupled
slender beams (no shear deformation); square tubes, one pair of walls upright
only the U at this station: the towers, the dash and the other station's U are not in this model
formulas.source: the unit-load (force) method for a statically indeterminate frame and beam bending and Bredt's torsion (textbook structures); the ladder's warping torsion (Vlasov) gives theta and k_y

formulas.title: 2 か所の溶接の疲労の損傷のうち大きいほう (フレームの寿命はいちばん傷む溶接で決まる)
formulas.expression: D = max(D_a, D_b); which = 1 if D_a >= D_b else 2
assumptions: the frame's life is that of its most damaged weld (Miner's rule at each weld point separately)
formulas.source: Miner's rule applied per weld point (textbook fatigue)

formulas.title: モーターのトルクで決まる駆動輪の力の最大
formulas.expression: F_max = T*i*eta/rolling_radius

T.description: largest motor torque (at the motor shaft)

i.description: overall reduction ratio from the motor to the wheels

eta.description: efficiency from motor shaft to wheels

rolling_radius.description: rolling radius of the driven wheels: the radius under the static wheel load (the mean when they differ)

F_max.description: largest tractive force at the driven wheels, all of them together

assumptions: the motor's largest torque reaches the wheels through the reduction ratio, less the losses (eta)
the force acts at the rolling radius (the radius under the static wheel load; the free radius only for a design without tyre stiffness)
grip not checked: the road may not take this force
formulas.source: definition: wheel torque T i eta divided by the wheel radius

formulas.title: 操作部の握る点 (踏む面) の動き: 触れている所のばねの直列と、通る板の帯と、着く部材の片持ちの曲げとねじれと、その根元
formulas.expression: delta = F / k_t + F / k_r + delta_plate + F L^3 / (3 E I) + F r_t^2 L / (G J) + delta_root

F.description: the hand or foot force at the control

k_t.description: the contacts' translation stiffness in series along the chain

k_r.description: the contacts' rotation stiffness seen at the load point (k_rot / r^2 for each, in series)

L.description: the frame member's length from the landing point to its nearest node

I.description: its smaller second moment of area

delta_plate.description: the load point's movement from the plates the chain passes through (load_path.plate_strip, summed; 0 without plates)

G.description: the shear modulus of the member the chain lands on

r_t.description: the load's lever about that member's axis at the landing point (its moment about the axis over F)

delta_root.description: the load point's movement from the node the cantilever starts at, when that node is partway up a straight column (load_path.post_node; 0 when the node is taken as rigid)

assumptions: 部品は剛体。触れている所だけがばね
握る点から枠までは、触れている所のいちばん短い鎖 1 本 (並んだ別の道は入れない: 予測は柔らかめ)
回る向きのばねは、触れた所から荷重の点までの腕の長さで、点の動きに直す
鎖が板を通るときは、荷重の来る所から板の中心までの板の帯の曲げとねじれ (load_path.plate_strip、中心は固定)
着いた部材は、いちばん近い節から片持ち (その節に部材がほかに無ければ、もう一方の端から)。曲げは小さい方の I、ねじれは荷重の部材の軸まわりのモーメント F r_t を着いた所から根元までの長さで受ける
根元の節がまっすぐな柱の途中にあれば、柱の両端を固定とみて、その節の動きを足す (load_path.post_node)。それより先のフレームは硬いとみる (柱の根元の枠が動く分は入らない: 予測は小さめ)
formulas.source: springs in series and a cantilever with an end load, delta = P L^3 / (3 E I), and its twist, theta = T L / (G J), read along the load as F r_t^2 L / (G J) (textbook statics)

formulas.title: 板の上の点の荷重: 板の中心から荷重の来る所までの板の帯 (中心で固定した片持ち) の曲げとねじれ
formulas.expression: w(s) = min(w_0 + c s, w_1); K_k = int_0^L s^k / w(s) ds; m_c = r_n F_a - r_a F_n; m_a = r_c F_n - r_n F_c; d_n = 12 (m_c K_1 + F_n K_2) / (E t^3); th_c = 12 (m_c K_0 + F_n K_1) / (E t^3); th_a = 3 m_a K_0 / (G t^3); w = d_n - th_c r_a + th_a r_c; delta = sqrt(w^2 + (th_c r_n)^2 + (th_a r_n)^2)

F_n.description: the load across the plate (along its normal n)

F_a.description: the load along the strip (a: from where the load comes on toward the plate's centre)

F_c.description: the load across the strip in the plate's plane (c = n x a)

r_n.description: the load point off the strip's end, along n

r_a.description: the load point off the strip's end, along a

r_c.description: the load point off the strip's end, along c

L.description: the strip's length: from where the load comes on to the plate's centre

w_0.description: the strip's width where the load comes on (the contact's width)

w_1.description: its width at the centre: w_0 + c L, at most the plate's width across the strip

c.description: the width's growth per length (2 tan of the spread angle)

delta.description: the load point's movement from the strip

theta_bend.description: the strip end's rotation about the axis across the strip

theta_twist.description: the strip end's twist about the strip's axis

assumptions: 板の中心は動かず回らない (板のほかの触れた所が中心を押さえる)。帯は中心で固定した片持ち。そのため、中心が動いて回る板では、この式は小さめに出る (v1 でブレーキを隔壁に寄せた形: 中心が 1.9 mm 動き 0.02 rad 回り、帯の端で約 5.4 mm の分が入らず、ツールより 30 % 小さい)
帯の幅は荷重の来る所で触れた面の幅 w_0、中心へ c (= 2 tan 45°) で広がり、板の幅 w_1 まで (ツールと同じ考え)
曲げは I = w t³/12、ねじれは薄い帯の J = w t³/3。板の面内の曲げ・伸びは硬いとみて入れない
荷重の点は帯の端に剛につながる (ペダルと台は剛体)。小さな変形の線形
formulas.source: a cantilever with an end force and an end moment by the unit-load method, delta = int M m / (E I) ds, theta = int M / (E I) ds, twist = int T / (G J) ds (textbook statics); int s^k / (w_0 + c s) ds in closed form

formulas.title: 柱の途中の節の動き: 両端を固定した柱 (2 本の区間) に、節で力とモーメントが掛かるとき、荷重の点の力の向きの動き

F.description: the load's size

T.description: its moment about the column's axis at the node

P_1.description: its part across the column along u_1

M_1.description: its moment at the node about e x u_1

P_2.description: its part across the column along u_2 = e x u_1

M_2.description: its moment at the node about e x u_2

a.description: the column's length from the node to one clamped end

I_1.description: its second moment of area for bending along u_1

delta.description: the load point's movement along the load from the column

assumptions: 柱の両端 (節から a と b の所) は固定 (そこから先の枠は硬いとみる)。そのため、枠が動く所では小さめに出る
柱はまっすぐな 1 本の断面 (2 つの区間は同じ断面)。節から荷重の点までは剛 (その間の部材の曲げは別の項)
小さな変形の線形。荷重の点の力の向きの動きは、荷重のする仕事 (F・u + M・θ = F δ) から出す
formulas.source: the beam element's end stiffness 12 E I / l^3, 6 E I / l^2, 4 E I / l for a segment clamped at its far end, two segments summed at the node; torsion G J / l and axial E A / l (textbook statics); Clapeyron's theorem for the movement along the load

formulas.title: 横の棒を点 R で外へ押したときの動き: 両端を固定した棒の曲げと、棒の両端を受ける柱 (足からの片持ち) の曲げ
formulas.expression: delta = F a^3 b^3 / (3 E I L^3) + (b/L)^2 F h_A^3 / (3 E_A I_A) + (a/L)^2 F h_B^3 / (3 E_B I_B); L = a + b

F.description: the push across the bar

a.description: from the bar's end A to the pushed point

b.description: from the pushed point to the bar's end B

I.description: the bar's smaller second moment of area

h_A.description: the post under end A: from its foot up to the bar (0: no post, the end held)

I_A.description: its smaller second moment of area

h_B.description: the post under end B, as h_A

I_B.description: its smaller second moment of area

delta.description: the pushed point's movement along the push

assumptions: 棒の両端は柱に固定 (回らない)。棒の曲げは両端固定の梁の 1 点の荷重
棒の両端の力 (F b/L と F a/L) は、それぞれの柱の足からの片持ちの先に掛かる。柱の足 (出っ張りの腕・レール) は硬いとみる。ほかの棒が柱どうしをつなぐ分は入れない (柱は同じ向きに動くので)。そのため柱の足が動く分だけ小さめに出る
押す点の動きは、柱の先の動きを棒の上で直線に分けた値 (b/L と a/L) を、仕事で力の向きに読む
formulas.source: a clamped-clamped beam with a point load, P a^3 b^3 / (3 E I L^3), and a cantilever with an end load, P h^3 / (3 E I), by the unit-load method (textbook statics)

formulas.title: はしご形の枠のレールの 1 点: 上下の曲げ、2 本で一緒に受ける横の曲げ、軸の力、ねじれを合わせた応力の、許しに対する割合
formulas.expression: sigma = M_v (h/2) / I_v + M_h (s/2 + b/2) / (2 (A (s/2)^2 + I_h)) + N / A; tau = T / (2 (b - t)(h - t) t); u = sqrt(sigma^2 + 3 tau^2) SF / f_y

M_v.description: the rail's bending moment up and down at the point

M_h.description: the two rails' sideways bending moment together at the point

T.description: the rail's twisting moment at the point

N.description: the rail's axial force (its share of the fore-and-aft force)

I_v.description: its second moment of area for bending up and down

u.description: von Mises stress over yield / SF

sigma.description: the normal stress at the corner

tau.description: the shear stress of the twist (Bredt)

assumptions: 上下の曲げ・横の曲げ・軸の力の応力は、レールの角で全部同じ向きに重なるとみる (大きめ)
横の曲げは、横の部材を溶接で付けたはしご形の枠が 1 つの枠として受けるとみて、2 本のレールの断面を 1 つにした形 I = 2 (A (s/2)^2 + I_h) で出す。これははしご形の横の硬さの上限 (横の部材が限りなく硬い) で、横の部材が曲がる分 (各レールが自分で曲がる分) は入らない。そのため、この項は小さめに出て、不利な側とは限らない
手計算はレールだけを見る。横の部材・柱・ロールバーの応力は入らない
ねじれは閉じた薄い管 (Bredt) の τ = T / (2 A_m t)、A_m = (b - t)(h - t)
曲げ・ねじれの値は、レールを車軸の 2 点で支えた梁と軸として、荷重から静力学で出す (load_path の builder)
formulas.source: beam bending sigma = M c / I, a ladder frame's two rails as one section in sideways bending (I = 2 (A (s/2)^2 + I_h)), Bredt's formula for a closed thin tube, von Mises sqrt(sigma^2 + 3 tau^2) (textbook strength of materials)

formulas.title: はしご形の枠のレールと、部品を下げたロールバーの柱の、応力の許しに対する割合の大きい方
formulas.expression: sigma = M_v (h/2) / I_v + M_h (s/2 + b/2) / (2 (A (s/2)^2 + I_h)) + N / A; tau = T / (2 (b - t)(h - t) t); u = sqrt(sigma^2 + 3 tau^2) SF / f_y; post: sigma_p = M_p c_p / I_p + N_p / A_p, tau_p = T_p c_p / J_p, u_p = sqrt(sigma_p^2 + 3 tau_p^2) SF / f_yp; u = max(u_rail, u_p)

M_v.description: the rail's bending moment up and down at the point

M_h.description: the two rails' sideways bending moment together at the point

T.description: the rail's twisting moment at the point

N.description: the rail's axial force (its share of the fore-and-aft force)

I_v.description: its second moment of area for bending up and down

M_p.description: the post's bending moment at its foot (0 without a post carrying parts)

T_p.description: its twisting moment at the foot

I_p.description: its smaller second moment of area

c_p.description: its extreme fibre's distance from the axis

u.description: the larger utilisation of the rail and the post

von_mises_post.description: the post's von Mises stress at its foot

assumptions: 上下の曲げ・横の曲げ・軸の力の応力は、レールの角で全部同じ向きに重なるとみる (大きめ)
横の曲げは、横の部材を溶接で付けたはしご形の枠が 1 つの枠として受けるとみて、2 本のレールの断面を 1 つにした形 I = 2 (A (s/2)^2 + I_h) で出す。これははしご形の横の硬さの上限 (横の部材が限りなく硬い) で、横の部材が曲がる分 (各レールが自分で曲がる分) は入らない。そのため、この項は小さめに出て、不利な側とは限らない
レールは load_path.rail_utilisation と同じ (横の部材の応力は入らない)
ロールバーの柱は、足の節からの片持ち。上の横の棒が柱の先を押さえる分は入れない (大きめ)
柱に金具で下げた部品 (座席など) と、それに座る乗員の重さと加速度は、全部その柱が持つとみる。座席が床にも留まっていても、床の分は引かない (大きめ)
柱の足で、曲げ・軸の力の応力を重ね、ねじれは円管の τ = T c / J (角管でも同じ式: 近似)
柱に何も下がっていなければ、柱の分は 0
ねじれは閉じた薄い管 (Bredt) の τ = T / (2 A_m t)、A_m = (b - t)(h - t)
曲げ・ねじれの値は、レールを車軸の 2 点で支えた梁と軸として、荷重から静力学で出す (load_path の builder)
formulas.source: beam bending sigma = M c / I, a ladder frame's two rails as one section in sideways bending (I = 2 (A (s/2)^2 + I_h)), Bredt's formula for a closed thin tube, von Mises sqrt(sigma^2 + 3 tau^2) (textbook strength of materials); a cantilever post's foot moment from statics, sigma = M c / I + N / A, tau = T c / J

formulas.title: 操作部の握る点 (踏む面) の動きを上から押さえる値 (補エネルギー: 触れている所の鎖 1 本と、板を入れない部材だけの枠)
formulas.expression: delta = F / sqrt(k_e k_tr); delta_along = F / k_e

F.description: the hand force at the grip or the foot force on the pedal's face

k_e.description: 1 over the bound on the compliance along the load: the chain of contacts carrying it all (1/k_t + |r x e|^2/k_r for each, in series) plus the members-only frame's at the landing point (the force and its moment about there)

k_tr.description: 1 over the same bounds along x, y and z summed (bounds the trace of the point's flexibility)

delta.description: the bound on the length of the point's movement

delta_along.description: the bound on its movement along the load

assumptions: 部品は剛体、触れている所はツールと同じばね (k_t 3 方向、k_r 3 軸)。力は全部、いちばん短い鎖 1 本を通るとみる (ほかの道は 0: 釣り合っている力の分布の 1 つなので、動きは上から押さえられる)
枠は部材だけの 3 次元の梁 (板・ほかの部品は力を持たないとみる)。支えはツールと同じピン。鎖の着く所に、力と、握る点からの腕によるモーメントを掛ける
動きの大きさ |u| は、3 つの向きの押さえの和 (柔らかさの行列の跡) を使うので、荷重の向きの押さえより最大 √3 倍大きめ
formulas.source: complementary energy theorem (an equilibrium set of internal forces gives an upper bound on the loaded point's movement along the load, textbook energy methods); for a positive semi-definite C, |C f|^2 = f C^2 f <= lambda_max f C f <= trace(C) f C f

formulas.title: どこにも繋がらない部品の数 (触れている所を部材からたどる)
formulas.expression: n = n_parts - n_held

n_parts.description: parts counted: every part modelled as a rigid body, or (the path check of a load case) the parts the load case loads

n_held.description: those a chain of contacts joins to a frame member

n.description: parts joined to nothing that holds them

assumptions: 触れている所はどれも 6 方向に硬い (1 か所で触れれば、その部品は止まる)
formulas.source: graph search over the contacts (counting)

formulas.title: フェンダーが覆わない踏面の弧 (車軸の真上から前 a_f・後ろ a_r の範囲で、接線に飛ぶ物が当たらない所)
formulas.expression: alpha = acos(R / (R + g)); covered = |[-a_f, a_r] ∩ [-f + alpha, r + alpha]| (0 when f + r = 0); arc = a_f + a_r - covered; arc_radial = max(0, a_f - f) + max(0, a_r - r)

a_f.description: arc to cover ahead of the top (Q87)

a_r.description: arc to cover behind the top (Q88)

f.description: how far the fender reaches ahead of the top (0: no fender)

r.description: how far the fender reaches behind the top (0: no fender)

g.description: the fender's inner face over the tyre (0: no fender)

arc.description: arc of [-a_f, a_r] whose tangent lines miss the fender

arc_radial.description: arc of [-a_f, a_r] not under the fender seen from the axle

alpha.description: how far ahead of its start a tangent line meets the fender's circle

assumptions: the arc a_f ahead of the top and a_r behind it is the requirements' Q87 and Q88, borrowed from a public-road rule for other traffic (告示 第178条 第2項 第1号); applying it to the occupants is an assumption
angles at the wheel centre from straight above the axle (the ladder_4w fender angles)
what leaves the tread flies straight along the tangent, the way the tread moves going forward (seen from the vehicle: toward the front); no gravity, no air, not in reverse
the fender is a circular arc of radius R + g from f ahead of the top to r behind, at least as wide as the tyre; nothing else covers the tread
a tangent line from the point theta meets that circle at theta - alpha (it leaves toward the front), so the fender covers the points from -f + alpha to r + alpha

arc_radial (max(0, a_f - f) + max(0, a_r - r)) reads the fender as seen from the axle, but what flies along the tangent from the points between -f and -f + alpha passes the fender's front end; it is kept as an output only (with the default fender, 30 and 50 deg and a 40 mm gap, it gives 0 deg where the lines leave 28 deg of the arc uncovered)
formulas.source: plane geometry of a tangent to a circle (a line tangent at radius R meets the circle R + g at the angle acos(R / (R + g)))

formulas.title: 踏面から飛ぶ線のうち、乗員に届く数 (乗員の体の部分とフェンダーだけを見て)
formulas.expression: n = n_aim - n_cover

n_aim.description: lines off the arc that meet an occupant's body part (nothing else in the way)

n_cover.description: of those, lines that meet the fender first

assumptions: the arc a_f ahead of the top and a_r behind it is the requirements' Q87 and Q88, borrowed from a public-road rule for other traffic (告示 第178条 第2項 第1号); applying it to the occupants is an assumption

only the occupants' body-part boxes and the fender (a circular arc from the design's fender angles, gap and width) are in the scene: no other part, no frame member, no ground, so no fewer lines reach than in the full scene
the tread points and lines as hiraku.solvers.k0_handcalc.spray_inputs.tread_lines (the load case's arc, arc_step, lines_across, line_length)
formulas.source: counting (spray_inputs.spray_reach_inputs counts the lines)

formulas.title: 座席の横の、座面より上の空きの前後の幅 (横の枠の前の柱から、座った人の足先まで)
formulas.expression: W = max(0, x_f - max(x_b, x_p + d / 2))

x_f.description: front of the seat's span (the person's feet)

x_b.description: rear of the seat's span (the seat box's rear face)

x_p.description: the side frame's front post's centre line (x_b without a side frame)

d.description: the side frame's tube diameter (0 without a side frame)

W.description: clear width along x beside the seat above the seat top

assumptions: the seat's span along x: from the seat box's rear face x_b to the front of the seated person's body parts x_f (k4_geometry.entry.seat_spaces); the opening is looked for there (an assumption)

the side frame's bars run from its rear post to its front post x_p and block everything behind the front post above the seat top; ahead of it nothing reaches outboard of the seat (the tool sees every member and part)
formulas.source: plane geometry (intervals along x)

formulas.title: 開口の座面から上の空きの高さ (横の枠の棒がまたぐときは下の棒の下面まで、またがなければ上に何も無い)
formulas.expression: W = max(0, x_f - max(x_b, x_p + d / 2)); H = max(0, h_low - d / 2) if W < W_req else H_cap

x_f.description: front of the seat's span (the person's feet)

x_b.description: rear of the seat's span (the seat box's rear face)

x_p.description: the side frame's front post's centre line (x_b without a side frame)

d.description: the side frame's tube diameter (0 without a side frame)

h_low.description: the side frame's lowest bar's centre line over the seat top (H_cap without a side frame)

W_req.description: the opening's required width above the seat (Q93)

H_cap.description: the height reported when nothing is above (assumption)

H.description: clear height above the seat top over a width W_req

W.description: the clear width ahead of the front post (entry.opening_width)

assumptions: the seat's span along x: from the seat box's rear face x_b to the front of the seated person's body parts x_f (k4_geometry.entry.seat_spaces); the opening is looked for there (an assumption)

when the clear stretch ahead of the front post is narrower than W_req, any W_req wide place is under the side frame's lowest bar; otherwise nothing is above the opening (no roof, the roll bar's top beam behind the seat)
formulas.source: plane geometry (intervals along x and z)

formulas.title: 地面から床の上面までの高さ (最初に足を置く面、段の無いとき)
formulas.expression: h = z_rail + h_rail / 2 + gap + t - z_g

gap.description: the floor's underside over the rails' top (ladder_4w: ON_RAILS_MM)

z_g.description: the ground: the lowest tyre bottom (wheel centre less radius)

assumptions: the floor lies on the rails (its underside gap over their top) and is the first surface a foot goes on (no step)
the vehicle stands on level ground at rest
formulas.source: adding heights

formulas.title: 開口の形に入る、横の枠の部材と開けられない網の数 (K0 の置き方で)
formulas.expression: n = n_frame + n_fixed

n_frame.description: the side frame's posts and bars in the doorway placed at x0 = max(x_b, x_p + d / 2), kept within the span

n_fixed.description: nets of kind side_net that do not open (not held by clips alone) in it

assumptions: the seat's span along x: from the seat box's rear face x_b to the front of the seated person's body parts x_f (k4_geometry.entry.seat_spaces); the opening is looked for there (an assumption)

the doorway: Q93 wide from the seat top up to max(seat top + Q95, floor + Q96), and Q94 wide from the floor up to the seat top at its front end; placed just ahead of the side frame's front post (the tool tries every place and sees every member and part)
only the side frame (its round posts and bars) and the nets are seen
formulas.source: counting (entry_inputs.entry_blocked_inputs counts the members)

formulas.title: 乗り降りの手がかりの数 (握れる太さの丸い部材で、座席の横の範囲にあるもの)
formulas.expression: n = n_grip

n_grip.description: round members of outside diameter Q49 to Q89 on the seat's side, outboard of the seat's middle, meeting the seat's span along x and reaching below the floor + Q48

n.description: hand holds beside the seat (the fewest over the side seats)

assumptions: the seat's span along x: from the seat box's rear face x_b to the front of the seated person's body parts x_f (k4_geometry.entry.seat_spaces); the opening is looked for there (an assumption)
members only, each as its end points' box widened by its diameter (the tool also counts parts of kind grab_handle and rectangular tubes)
formulas.source: counting (entry_inputs.entry_handhold_inputs counts the members)

formulas.title: サスペンションの取付の金具のピンのせん断 (2 面せん断、軸部の断面)
formulas.expression: tau = |F_p| / (2 n pi d^2 / 4), |F_p| = sqrt(F_t^2 + F_v^2); f_v = 0.6 f_ub / 1.25; u = tau / f_v

F_t.description: |the in-plane force along the plates' base line|

F_v.description: |the in-plane force normal to the base| (pulling the plates off)

f_ub.description: pin tensile strength (grade 8.8: 800 MPa, ISO 898-1, not checked)

f_v.description: shear resistance per area alpha_v f_ub / gamma_M2

assumptions: two plates (a clevis) standing on the frame's surface, each fillet-welded on both sides along its base; the pin through both; each plate takes half of every force

the force is K2's at the mount point (the largest |F| of each upstream analysis; the worst utilisation over the analyses); the A-arm's force along the arm is split half and half between its two inner pivots by K2
recommended partial factors of EN 1993-1-8 (gamma_M0 1.0, gamma_M2 1.25), not a national annex

grade 8.8 pin

formulas.title: 最小回転半径 (全切りで回るときの、外側の前輪の接地の中心の円の半径。アッカーマン)
formulas.expression: cot(delta_o) = cot(delta_i) + t / L; R = L / sin(delta_o)

L.description: wheelbase: from the steered axle to the unsteered axle

t.description: track of the steered axle (between the wheels' contact centres)

delta_i.description: the inner front wheel's largest steer angle (max_steer_angle)

R.description: radius of the outer front wheel's contact centre at full lock

delta_o.description: the outer front wheel's angle at full lock

assumptions: Ackermann steering: every wheel rolls about one centre on the line of the unsteered axle
no tyre slip (a slow turn); the tyre turns about its contact point (no scrub radius)
full lock: the inner front wheel at its largest angle, the outer one at its Ackermann angle
formulas.source: Ackermann geometry: the steered wheels' axes meet on the line of the unsteered axle, so cot(delta_o) - cot(delta_i) = t / L, and the outer wheel turns about that point at L / sin(delta_o)

formulas.title: 回転半径の上限を守るのに要る切れ角 (内側の前輪。アッカーマン)
formulas.expression: delta_o = asin(L / R_max); cot(delta_i) = cot(delta_o) - t / L

L.description: wheelbase: from the steered axle to the unsteered axle

t.description: track of the steered axle (between the wheels' contact centres)

R_max.description: the largest turning radius allowed (outer front wheel)

delta_i.description: the inner front wheel's angle the limit needs

delta_o.description: the outer front wheel's angle the limit needs
